title: Cold Aisle Sensor Docking
description: Carry a temperature logger on a four-module square body along the 9 m cold aisle in 45 seconds. At the aisle end, approach the charging contact diagonally front-left over 0.6 m in 12 seconds, keeping the sensor facing the racks.
payload_desc: Temperature logger and low sensor mast
motion_rationale: The straight leg needs 0.2 m/s for 9 m in 45 seconds, while the fixed-heading diagonal docking approach needs 0.05 m/s for 0.6 m in 12 seconds.

title: Inverter Cabinet Thermal Survey
description: Move a thermal camera on three modules arranged in a line between four inverter cabinets, covering each 2.1 m aisle leg in 15 seconds. Stop in the marked turning pads and turn in place 90 degrees in 6 seconds, alternating clockwise and counter-clockwise to face the cabinet fronts.
payload_desc: Thermal camera and compact recording unit
motion_rationale: The cabinet spacing requires 0.14 m/s over each 2.1 m leg, and each stationary 90-degree camera reorientation takes 6 seconds at 15 deg/s.

title: Underwing Leak Camera Transfer
description: Carry a lightweight leak camera on a six-module block across a cleared indoor hangar lane beneath a parked wing. Cover the 26 m transit in 100 seconds, then slide right 0.45 m in 9 seconds to place the camera beneath the inspection mark without changing heading.
payload_desc: Upward-facing leak camera and battery
motion_rationale: The cleared 26 m lane calls for 0.26 m/s over 100 seconds, followed by a 0.05 m/s rightward slide over 0.45 m for camera placement.

title: Engine Room Bearing Scan
description: Carry an acoustic recorder along an 18 m straight bearing inspection lane on the ship's enclosed engine room deck, taking 90 seconds each way. Pause at marked bearings and reverse back along the same lane because the far end has no turning space.
payload_desc: Acoustic recorder with low microphone array
motion_rationale: Both the forward scan and reverse return cover 18 m in 90 seconds at 0.2 m/s, with separate stationary recording pauses.

title: Turbine Pedestal Clearance Survey
description: Carry a vibration data receiver on a four-module square body through a 0.48 m gap beside a turbine pedestal, advancing 3.6 m in 30 seconds. At the wider inspection pocket, slide left 0.12 m in 8 seconds to reach the reading position, then slide right before reversing out.
payload_desc: Vibration receiver and shielded data logger
motion_rationale: The narrow passage limits both straight legs to 0.12 m/s, while each 0.12 m lateral positioning move takes 8 seconds at 0.015 m/s.

title: Pipe Gallery Test Pack Delivery
description: Carry a 28 kg ultrasonic inspection pack on six modules arranged two wide and three long through the enclosed pipe gallery. Travel 12 m forward in 80 seconds, then slide left 0.6 m in 15 seconds into a wider work recess where a technician unloads the pack.
payload_desc: Ultrasonic test unit, probe case, and calibration blocks
motion_rationale: The secured heavy pack travels 12 m in 80 seconds at 0.15 m/s, with a slower 0.04 m/s lateral move covering 0.6 m in 15 seconds.

title: Underside Walkway Optical Survey
description: Carry a padded optical survey head along a level, enclosed maintenance walkway beneath the bridge deck. Advance 6.3 m in 90 seconds, then slide right 0.18 m in 12 seconds beneath the survey window while keeping the fragile instrument facing forward.
payload_desc: Fragile optical survey head in a padded cradle
motion_rationale: The fragile optical head needs a gentle 0.07 m/s straight transfer over 6.3 m and a 0.015 m/s lateral placement over 0.18 m.

title: Nacelle Sensor Shuttle
description: Carry a small thermal sensor on a two-module body along the cleared 5.2 m service strip inside a shut-down nacelle, reaching the gearbox station in 20 seconds. After recording, reverse along the same strip at the same transit speed because the cable channel prevents turning.
payload_desc: Compact thermal sensor and recorder
motion_rationale: The short inspection window requires each 5.2 m forward or reverse transit to take 20 seconds at 0.26 m/s.

title: Cleanroom Particle Sampling Circuit
description: Carry a particle counter on six modules through the cleanroom bay, advancing 8.4 m in 60 seconds and sliding left 0.4 m in 10 seconds to sample beside a tool. Slide right to clear the tool, turn clockwise 90 degrees in 9 seconds on the open pad, then travel diagonally front-right 1.2 m in 12 seconds to the next sampling mark.
payload_desc: Particle counter with low sampling inlet
motion_rationale: The route uses 0.14 m/s forward transit, 0.04 m/s sampling offsets, a 10 deg/s pad turn, and a 0.1 m/s diagonal transfer to meet the stated distances and times.

title: Column Base Crack Imaging
description: Carry a low crack camera on two modules arranged fore-and-aft through a 0.3 m gap between a parking column and a protective rail. Advance and reverse over the same 2.4 m strip in 30 seconds each way, sliding left and right by 0.02 m in 4 seconds at the imaging marks.
payload_desc: Close-focus crack camera with illumination
motion_rationale: The rail gap requires 0.08 m/s straight travel over 2.4 m and 0.005 m/s lateral corrections of only 0.02 m.

title: Ward Supply Cabinet Circuit
description: Deliver sealed dressing packs to three ward supply cabinets on a two-module body, covering each 4.8 m corridor leg in 30 seconds. Turn in place 90 degrees in 3 seconds at the clear junctions, using clockwise and counter-clockwise turns to present the tray handle to staff.
payload_desc: Sealed tray of dressing packs
motion_rationale: Clear corridor legs need 0.16 m/s for 4.8 m in 30 seconds, and the repeated 90-degree tray presentations take 3 seconds at 30 deg/s.

title: Guest Room Breakfast Delivery
description: Carry a covered breakfast tray on one module along a straight 22 m hotel corridor in 110 seconds. At the room's recessed doorway, slide right 0.3 m in 10 seconds so the tray can be lifted without blocking the corridor.
payload_desc: Compact covered breakfast tray with capped drink
motion_rationale: The long corridor requires 0.2 m/s over 22 m, while the doorway placement slows to 0.03 m/s for a 0.3 m rightward slide.

title: Baggage Tag Stock Express
description: Carry replacement baggage-tag rolls between two staffed desks across a closed service lane in the baggage hall. Drive forward 19.5 m in 75 seconds, then cross the open desk apron diagonally front-left over 2.4 m in 10 seconds to reach the receiving shelf.
payload_desc: Small bin of baggage-tag rolls and printer ribbons
motion_rationale: The reserved lane permits 0.26 m/s for the 19.5 m express leg, and the unobstructed 2.4 m diagonal apron crossing takes 10 seconds at 0.24 m/s.

title: Ceramic Kit Line Delivery
description: Carry a foam-lined tray of ceramic sensor housings on a four-module square body from inspection to the assembly line, covering 7.2 m in 90 seconds. Slide left 0.24 m in 12 seconds beneath the receiving shelf, then slide right after unloading and reverse along the same lane.
payload_desc: Foam-lined tray of fragile ceramic sensor housings
motion_rationale: The fragile kit limits straight travel to 0.08 m/s for each 7.2 m leg and shelf insertion to 0.02 m/s for each 0.24 m slide.

title: Returned Books Sorting Circuit
description: Carry a shallow bin of returned books on four modules between three sorting desks, covering each 3.6 m leg in 24 seconds. Turn in place 180 degrees in 5 seconds at the first desk and 90 degrees in 2.5 seconds in the opposite direction at the next, so the bin opening faces each librarian.
payload_desc: Shallow return bin containing mixed library books
motion_rationale: Desk transfers need 0.15 m/s for 3.6 m in 24 seconds, while both the half-turn and quarter-turn presentations require 36 deg/s.

title: Sample Rack Analyzer Transfer
description: Carry a capped sample rack on one module, moving forward 3.6 m in 30 seconds and diagonally front-right 0.6 m in 10 seconds around a fixed bench corner. Turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees in 10 seconds, slide left 0.15 m in 10 seconds into the handoff position, then slide right and reverse 0.6 m in 10 seconds after unloading.
payload_desc: Capped sample rack inside a sealed carrier
motion_rationale: The forward leg sets the 0.12 m/s surge peak, while the bench diagonal needs 0.06 m/s, the handoff slides need 0.015 m/s, and the 90-degree turn needs 9 deg/s.

title: Backroom Cosmetics Restock
description: Carry a tote of boxed cosmetics on two modules through a backroom route with four alternating right-angle bends. Cover each 2.7 m straight section in 15 seconds and turn in place 90 degrees in 2 seconds inside the clear stockroom junctions before delivering to the replenishment counter.
payload_desc: Secured tote of boxed cosmetics
motion_rationale: The short straight sections require 0.18 m/s over 2.7 m, and each alternating 90-degree junction turn takes 2 seconds at 45 deg/s.

title: Partition Gap Fastener Delivery
description: Carry a lidded fastener box on two modules arranged fore-and-aft through a 0.32 m opening between temporary indoor partitions. Advance 4.2 m in 35 seconds, slide right 0.12 m in 8 seconds inside the wider receiving area, then slide left and reverse out after the box is lifted.
payload_desc: Lidded box of partition fasteners and brackets
motion_rationale: The partition passage calls for 0.12 m/s on the 4.2 m entry and reverse exit, while each 0.12 m receiving-area slide takes 8 seconds at 0.015 m/s.

title: Dead End Camera Dolly Take
description: Carry a compact remotely operated camera on four modules into a studio set's dead-end corridor, making a 4.8 m forward tracking shot in 60 seconds. Reverse the same distance in 60 seconds without turning the camera, then slide left 0.36 m in 12 seconds in the open reset area.
payload_desc: Compact camera, stabilizing head, and battery
motion_rationale: Both 4.8 m tracking legs need 0.08 m/s to last 60 seconds, and the 0.36 m reset slide takes 12 seconds at 0.03 m/s.

title: Gallery Label Cart Docking
description: Carry replacement label holders and a small tool case on three modules arranged in a line across the closed museum gallery. Travel forward 10.8 m in 90 seconds, then approach the conservator's handoff dock diagonally front-left over 0.72 m in 18 seconds between two display plinths, keeping the tray heading fixed.
payload_desc: Replacement label holders and compact tool case
motion_rationale: The gallery crossing requires 0.12 m/s for 10.8 m in 90 seconds, followed by a careful 0.04 m/s diagonal approach over 0.72 m in 18 seconds.

title: Dense Parts Bin Picking
description: Carry a 19 kg bin of steel fittings on a four-module square body out of a narrow picking aisle. Reverse 8.1 m in 45 seconds from the loading position, turn clockwise 90 degrees in 6 seconds in the cross-aisle, then advance 5.4 m in 30 seconds to the packing bench.
payload_desc: Low bin of steel fittings
motion_rationale: The loaded reverse and forward legs both need 0.18 m/s for their specified travel times, with a controlled 90-degree cross-aisle turn at 15 deg/s.

title: Small Pallet Cross Dock Shuttle
description: Carry a 0.4 m square display pallet on four modules from a dead-end staging pocket to the dispatch pocket across the cross-dock. Reverse 3.6 m in 20 seconds, slide right 6 m in 30 seconds across the reserved transfer lane, then advance 3.6 m in 20 seconds into the receiving pocket without turning.
payload_desc: Small display pallet with boxed accessories, including pallet
motion_rationale: Each 3.6 m pocket leg takes 20 seconds at 0.18 m/s, while the unobstructed 6 m sideways cross-dock transfer takes 30 seconds at 0.2 m/s.

title: Tote Station Precision Handoff
description: Carry a component tote on four modules along the 6.6 m shelf-to-station lane in 30 seconds, slowing for the final approach. At the station, turn counter-clockwise 2 degrees in 4 seconds and slide left 0.04 m in 8 seconds to align the tote with the manual transfer guides.
payload_desc: Component tote with molded internal dividers
motion_rationale: A 0.24 m/s transit peak allows the 6.6 m lane to be covered in 30 seconds with approach slowing, while final alignment uses 0.005 m/s sway and 0.5 deg/s yaw.

title: Rack Scanner Diagonal Return
description: Carry a barcode scanner on two modules along a 14.4 m rack face in 80 seconds, then reverse the same distance while checking the opposite-facing labels. Near the starting point, move diagonally rear-right 0.9 m in 15 seconds into the offset charging dock without turning the scanner body.
payload_desc: Dual-facing barcode scanner and recorder
motion_rationale: Both 14.4 m scanning passes require 0.18 m/s over 80 seconds, and the fixed-heading rear-right docking leg needs 0.06 m/s for 0.9 m in 15 seconds.

title: Trailer Dense Carton Unload
description: Receive a 14 kg carton on three modules arranged fore-and-aft inside a stationary enclosed trailer, then reverse 7.2 m in 60 seconds to the indoor receiving bay. Cross only the flush, level bridge plate and slide left 0.48 m in 12 seconds on the bay floor to present the carton at the unloading bench.
payload_desc: Dense carton of machine spares
motion_rationale: The near-capacity carton needs a controlled 0.12 m/s reverse transfer over 7.2 m in 60 seconds and a 0.04 m/s bay-floor slide over 0.48 m in 12 seconds.

title: Camera Traverse Beside Fallen Partitions
description: Carry a search camera through a cleared, level strip beside fallen corridor partitions using a 2x2 body. Travel forward along the 6 m strip in about 40 seconds, then slide left 0.24 m over 12 seconds to view a void; slide right and reverse along the same route without turning.
payload_desc: Secured search camera, lamp, and radio relay
motion_rationale: A 0.16 m/s forward and reverse peak allows roughly 40 seconds per 6 m leg including gentle acceleration, while the left and right viewing offsets require 0.02 m/s.

title: Office Smoke Survey Circuit
description: Carry a thermal camera and gas sensor from the office entrance to three marked survey positions on a cleared floor. Run forward 8 m in about 40 seconds, slide right 0.8 m in 10 seconds, and cross a 2.4 m diagonal gap toward the front-left in 20 seconds; turn clockwise 90 degrees in 6 seconds in the open copier bay before the final forward leg.
payload_desc: Thermal camera and secured gas-monitor package
motion_rationale: The timed corridor run needs a 0.21 m/s forward peak, the right offset and front-left crossing need 0.08 and 0.12 m/s, and the clockwise quarter-turn requires 15 deg/s.

title: Garage Radio Battery Delivery
description: Deliver a spare radio battery to a rescue team across a parking garage using two modules docked end to end. Follow a swept 18 m lane forward in about 70 seconds, then slide left 0.6 m in 10 seconds into the handoff pocket beside a debris pile.
payload_desc: Radio battery and charging adapter in a latched case
motion_rationale: The 18 m delivery lane needs a near-limit 0.265 m/s forward peak to finish in about 70 seconds, followed by a 0.06 m/s left slide for the handoff.

title: Basement Sensor Dock Approach
description: Carry a sealed water-quality sampler over the flat basement slab through a surveyed film of water within the modules' approved operating depth. Move forward 4 m in about 45 seconds, then approach the receiver diagonally front-right along a 1.8 m path in 30 seconds, reducing speed over the final docking markers.

constraints: water depth verified within equipment rating

payload_desc: Sealed water-quality sampler in a restrained cradle
motion_rationale: A 0.095 m/s forward peak supports the cautious 4 m traverse, and a 0.065 m/s front-right diagonal peak leaves time to slow before docking.

title: Tunnel Air Monitor Shuttle
description: Carry an air monitor from the tunnel staging point to a marked sampling station 55 m down a cleared, level service strip. Drive forward there and reverse back with the sensor facing the same direction, allowing about four minutes for each travel leg and a one-minute sampling stop.
payload_desc: Air monitor, battery, and telemetry unit
motion_rationale: A 0.235 m/s peak in both forward and reverse supports each 55 m leg in approximately four minutes with acceleration and stopping.

title: Evacuation Alcove Radio Drop
description: Take a small radio to the evacuation marshal at the end of a 7 m hospital storage spur using one module. Enter forward in about 50 seconds, stop for handoff, then reverse the full distance because parked equipment leaves no turning space.
payload_desc: Handheld radio secured in a small delivery tray
motion_rationale: A 0.145 m/s forward and reverse peak permits roughly 50 seconds for each 7 m leg while preserving controlled stops near equipment.

title: Landing Breathing Cylinder Transfer
description: Move an 18 kg breathing-cylinder kit between two crews already stationed on the same broad stairwell landing. With the cylinders strapped horizontally to a 2x2 body, drive forward 3 m in about 35 seconds and slide right 0.5 m in 10 seconds into the receiving zone without turning or approaching the stair edge.
payload_desc: Two breathing cylinders and harnesses in a restrained transport cradle
motion_rationale: The heavy restrained kit needs a gentle 0.09 m/s forward peak for the short traverse and a 0.05 m/s right slide into the receiving zone.

title: Fire Survey Instrument Placement
description: Carry a 24 kg monitoring case on a 2x3 body to a marked instrument position beside a fire-damaged warehouse rack. Travel forward 9 m in about 65 seconds, then slide left 0.18 m over 15 seconds and turn counter-clockwise 6 degrees over 5 seconds to align the case with the survey marks.

constraints: alignment bay clear of rack feet

payload_desc: Rugged structural-monitoring case with restrained internal instruments
motion_rationale: The approach needs a 0.145 m/s forward peak, while the measured alignment corrections require a 0.012 m/s left slide and 1.2 deg/s counter-clockwise yaw.

title: Carriage Emergency Radio Shuttle
description: Deliver a compact emergency radio from the carriage doorway to responders 16 m along the straight center aisle of a stationary, isolated train. Use two modules docked end to end to clear the seat ends, travel forward in about 64 seconds, and reverse back after handoff without turning.
payload_desc: Emergency radio and spare battery in a padded case
motion_rationale: A 0.26 m/s peak forward and reverse supports the approximately 64-second aisle legs while allowing acceleration and stopping at each end.

title: Refuge Chamber Supply Shuttle
description: Move a sealed oxygen-monitor service kit between the refuge chamber entrance and its equipment station 32 m along a straight internal service lane. Keep the three modules in a lengthwise row, drive forward in about 150 seconds, and reverse to the entrance after the kit is removed.
payload_desc: Sealed oxygen-monitor calibration and replacement-sensor kit
motion_rationale: A 0.22 m/s peak in each longitudinal direction covers the 32 m lane in about 150 seconds including start and stop allowances.

title: Rack Inlet Probe Alignment
description: Carry a short temperature-probe array down a data-centre cold aisle to a rack inlet measurement mark. Move forward 5 m in about 45 seconds, slide left 0.12 m over 12 seconds, and turn clockwise 4 degrees over 4 seconds to square the array; slide right again before reversing out.

constraints: probe remains clear of rack doors

payload_desc: Temperature-probe array and logger on a low rigid mount
motion_rationale: A 0.12 m/s longitudinal peak serves the 5 m aisle legs, while 0.01 m/s lateral movement and 1 deg/s clockwise yaw provide the specified probe alignment.

title: Inverter Thermal Reference Transfer
description: Carry a fragile calibrated thermal reference from its storage bench to the inspection position beside an isolated inverter cabinet. With the reference cushioned on one module, drive forward 4 m in about 55 seconds and slide right 0.35 m over 10 seconds without rotating the load.
payload_desc: Calibrated thermal reference with a fragile ceramic emitter
motion_rationale: The cushioned reference permits a gentle 0.08 m/s forward peak for the 4 m transfer and a 0.035 m/s right slide for final placement.

title: Underwing Camera Station Traverse
description: Carry a low inspection camera between two marked stations beneath the wing of a chocked aircraft. Travel diagonally front-left across a clear 12 m path in about 48 seconds, then slide right 0.45 m over 5 seconds to center the camera under the inspection target.

constraints: route clear of stands and hoses

payload_desc: Low-mounted inspection camera and battery
motion_rationale: A 0.26 m/s front-left diagonal peak meets the approximately 48-second station transfer, and a 0.09 m/s right slide centers the camera.

title: Engine Room Analyzer Delivery
description: Carry an 18.6 kg vibration-analyzer package on a 2x2 body along the engine room's continuous flush steel service deck. Drive forward 6 m in about 60 seconds, turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees over 12 seconds in a clear service square, and slide left 0.6 m over 12 seconds beside the measurement station.
payload_desc: Vibration analyzer, battery, and sensor kit in a restrained case
motion_rationale: The heavy analyzer needs a 0.11 m/s forward peak, a measured 0.05 m/s left approach, and a restrained 7.5 deg/s counter-clockwise quarter-turn.

title: Turbine Bearing Recess Survey
description: Carry a thermal camera into an 11 m blind service lane ending at a turbine bearing enclosure in the conventional turbine hall. Drive forward in about 70 seconds, slide right 0.25 m over 5 seconds to inspect behind a guard, then slide left and reverse out because the enclosure leaves no turning bay.

constraints: lateral viewing pocket only at lane end

payload_desc: Thermal camera and inspection recorder
motion_rationale: A 0.165 m/s forward and reverse peak supports the 11 m lane legs, while the guard-viewing offset and its recovery require 0.05 m/s lateral travel.

title: Pipe Gallery Optical Survey
description: Move a fragile optical alignment instrument through the flat pipe gallery using two modules docked lengthwise. Follow the 8 m straight passage forward in about 95 seconds, then take a 1.2 m front-right diagonal path over 24 seconds into a wider survey recess while keeping the instrument's heading fixed.

constraints: no pipe supports across wheel path

payload_desc: Optical alignment instrument with glass reference assembly
motion_rationale: A 0.09 m/s forward peak allows gentle starts along the 8 m gallery, and the 1.2 m front-right approach requires 0.05 m/s without yaw.

title: Blind Walkway Joint Inspection
description: Carry a compact camera along an enclosed, level maintenance walkway beneath the bridge deck to inspect a joint 14 m from the access bay. Drive forward in about 90 seconds, record the joint, and reverse to the bay because the walkway ends at a fixed barrier with no turnaround space.

constraints: no expansion gaps across robot route

payload_desc: Compact joint-inspection camera, light, and recorder
motion_rationale: A 0.16 m/s forward and reverse peak covers each 14 m walkway leg in approximately 90 seconds with controlled stops.

title: Nacelle Gearbox Camera Alignment
description: Position a low camera fixture beside the gearbox on the nacelle's surveyed flat service floor while the turbine is locked out. Move forward 2.4 m in about 35 seconds, slide right 0.16 m over 20 seconds, and turn counter-clockwise 3 degrees over 6 seconds to match the repeat-photography marks.

constraints: alignment zone clear of floor ribs

payload_desc: Low camera fixture and repeatable imaging target
motion_rationale: The short approach needs a 0.075 m/s forward peak, followed by a 0.008 m/s right slide and 0.5 deg/s counter-clockwise yaw for repeatable camera placement.

title: Cleanroom Particle Counter Traverse
description: Carry a compact particle counter between two sampling marks across a cleared cleanroom bay using a cleaned 2x2 body. Slide left 10 m in about 40 seconds while keeping the sampling inlet facing the tool row, then move forward 0.8 m over 10 seconds into the marked sampling box.
payload_desc: Compact particle counter with capped transport inlet
motion_rationale: The 10 m traverse requires a near-limit 0.26 m/s leftward peak while preserving inlet heading, followed by a 0.08 m/s forward placement move.

title: Column Scanner Viewpoint Circuit
description: Carry a fragile laser scanner on a low, restrained mount across a closed parking bay using a 2x3 body. Drive forward 5 m in about 60 seconds, slide left 1.2 m over 20 seconds to the second column viewpoint, and turn clockwise 90 degrees over 15 seconds in the marked clear square before recording.
payload_desc: Fragile laser scanner and padded low mounting frame
motion_rationale: Gentle peaks of 0.09 m/s forward and 0.06 m/s left meet the viewpoint transfers, while 6 deg/s clockwise yaw completes the quarter-turn without jolting the scanner.

title: Urgent Ward Dressing Delivery
description: Deliver a sealed dressing pack from the supply room to a ward handoff shelf along a reserved 24 m straight corridor. Drive forward in about 94 seconds, then slide right 0.4 m over 8 seconds into the recessed handoff position while keeping clear of the main walking lane.
payload_desc: Sealed dressing pack in a covered delivery tray
motion_rationale: A 0.265 m/s forward peak supports the urgent 24 m corridor leg in about 94 seconds, and a 0.05 m/s right slide enters the handoff recess.

title: Breakfast Tray Through Service Gap
description: Carry two covered breakfast boxes on a fitted deck across three modules docked in a lengthwise row. Drive forward 9 m in about 80 seconds through a 0.30 m gap beside a parked linen cart, then slide left 0.45 m over 15 seconds into the wider room-door recess; slide right and reverse along the same route after handoff.

constraints: sideways movement only in door recess

payload_desc: Two covered breakfast boxes secured in a narrow fitted carrier
motion_rationale: A 0.12 m/s longitudinal peak allows careful passage through the narrow gap, and 0.03 m/s left and right slides handle the tray handoff in the door recess.

title: Baggage Exception Case Transfer
description: Move two compact baggage exception cases totaling 26 kg on a 2x3 body from the inspection desk to the manual collection station. Follow a reserved 65 m straight lane forward in about 280 seconds, then slide right 0.8 m over 10 seconds into the collection pocket without turning.
payload_desc: Two compact baggage exception cases secured to the deck
motion_rationale: A sustained forward run peaking at 0.24 m/s meets the roughly 280-second lane transfer, and a 0.08 m/s right slide reaches the collection pocket.

title: Assembly Cell Kit Replenishment
description: Carry a latched fastener kit from the supermarket rack to an assembly cell using two docked modules. Drive forward 7 m in about 35 seconds, cross a 2.2 m front-right diagonal opening in 15 seconds, turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees over 4 seconds in the clear cell entrance, and slide left 0.3 m over 6 seconds to dock before reversing 0.5 m clear after unloading.
payload_desc: Latched fastener kit with fitted component compartments
motion_rationale: The rack leg needs a 0.21 m/s forward peak with a slower reverse clearance move, the diagonal opening needs 0.15 m/s, and docking requires 0.05 m/s left travel after a 22.5 deg/s counter-clockwise turn.

title: Returned Books Sorting Dock
description: Carry a strapped 14 kg stack of returned books from the intake desk to a sorting station on a 2x2 body. Drive forward 6 m in about 50 seconds, then follow a 1.5 m front-left diagonal path into the angled docking marks over 25 seconds, slowing for the last 0.15 m; reverse diagonally rear-right along the same path after unloading.

constraints: no loose rugs or floor cables

payload_desc: Returned books strapped inside a shallow sorting carrier
motion_rationale: A 0.13 m/s forward peak serves the 6 m transfer, while front-left docking and rear-right withdrawal peak at 0.07 m/s to leave time for the slow final alignment.

title: Pipe Gallery Gauge Survey
description: Carry a camera and lamp on a 2x2 body through a level pipe gallery, following an 8 m straight service passage. At three gauge banks, slide left toward the pipes and right back to the travel line without changing heading; allow 12 seconds for each 0.3 m approach. Reverse along the passage after the last reading because there is no turning pocket.
payload_desc: Low-mounted camera, inspection lamp, and recorder
motion_rationale: Forward and reverse peaks of 0.145 m/s support roughly one minute per 8 m leg, while lateral peaks of 0.028 m/s allow controlled 0.3 m gauge approaches in about 12 seconds.

title: Enclosed Bridge Walkway Instrument Delivery
description: Move a 14 kg ultrasonic inspection kit along the enclosed, level underside walkway inside a box-girder bridge. The three-module body travels 16 m forward to the technician, then reverses 2 m into a marked waiting recess without turning. Allow about two minutes for the loaded outward leg and pause at each steel plate joint.
payload_desc: Ultrasonic instrument, couplant, and probe case on a padded cradle
motion_rationale: Forward and reverse travel needs a 0.158 m/s peak to cover the 16 m loaded route in about two minutes while retaining time for slow plate-joint crossings.

title: Nacelle Borescope Head Transfer
description: Carry a fragile borescope head in a foam cradle across 3 m of the turbine's stationary, level nacelle floor. Keep the two-module body facing the gearbox and slide 0.24 m right into the technician's receiving position, allowing 10 seconds for that final movement. Slide left clear after unloading and reverse to the storage position.
payload_desc: Fragile borescope head and optical cable in a foam cradle
motion_rationale: Gentle forward and reverse peaks of 0.082 m/s give roughly 40-second transit legs, and 0.027 m/s lateral peaks fit the 0.24 m receiving approach into about 10 seconds.

title: Cleanroom Particle Counter Circuit
description: Carry a particle counter between three marked sampling locations in a cleanroom bay with approved wheel covers. Travel 6 m forward, slide left 0.6 m beside a tool face, then move 1.4 m diagonally front-right through an open bay intersection. Turn 90 degrees clockwise in the marked clear square in about six seconds before the final forward approach.
payload_desc: Compact particle counter with low sampling inlet
motion_rationale: A 0.173 m/s forward peak supports the 6 m transit in about 38 seconds, 0.067 m/s handles the 0.6 m side approach in about 10 seconds, 0.126 m/s covers the diagonal in about 12 seconds, and 19 deg/s permits a gentle six-second quarter-turn.

title: Parking Column Scan Traverse
description: Carry a low laser scanner and its battery on a 2x3 body down a closed, level parking-structure lane. Traverse 48 m forward in about 190 seconds, stopping at four columns for scans. At the far end, turn 180 degrees counter-clockwise inside a 2 m clear square and drive forward back to the start.
payload_desc: Low-profile laser scanner, battery, and protective frame
motion_rationale: The 48 m travel legs require a near-full 0.264 m/s forward peak, while the six-module body uses a reduced 32 deg/s peak for its approximately seven-second half-turn.

title: Ward Supply Alcove Delivery
description: Deliver sealed dressing packs along a 14 m hospital corridor to a dead-end supply alcove. The three-module body enters the alcove forward for 1.8 m and reverses the same distance after staff remove the tray. In the corridor's clear junction, turn 90 degrees counter-clockwise to return toward central stores.
payload_desc: Lidded tray of sealed dressing packs
motion_rationale: A 0.218 m/s surge peak supports roughly 70-second corridor legs with slower forward and reverse alcove travel, and 24 deg/s allows a five-second quarter-turn at the clear junction.

title: Banquet Crockery Corridor Transfer
description: Move 18.6 kg of stacked crockery in a latched low crate from the service pantry to a hotel banquet staging point 22 m down a carpeted corridor. Use a four-module square body and allow about two minutes for the straight forward trip. At the destination, slide 0.5 m right into a wall-side receiving space without rotating the crate.
payload_desc: Crockery crate with dividers and a secured lid
motion_rationale: A 0.203 m/s forward peak leaves acceleration margin within the two-minute 22 m trip, and a 0.046 m/s rightward peak gives about 12 seconds for the loaded 0.5 m placement.

title: Baggage Exception Pocket Retrieval
description: Enter a 3 m dead-end pocket beneath a stopped baggage inspection spur with an empty four-module body. Staff place a single 16 kg suitcase on the restrained deck, then the body reverses fully out without yawing. Slide 1.1 m left across the clear service lane to the exception desk, allowing about 10 seconds for the lateral transfer.
payload_desc: Single suitcase secured in a shallow restraint frame
motion_rationale: Forward and reverse peaks of 0.137 m/s allow roughly 25 seconds for each 3 m pocket leg, while a 0.124 m/s leftward peak completes the 1.1 m desk transfer in about 10 seconds.

title: Assembly Fixture Kit Exchange
description: Carry a 17.4 kg fixture kit forward along an 11 m factory service lane and into a 2.2 m dead-end line-side berth. Keep the four-module body aligned with the machine while an operator exchanges the kit for an empty tray. Reverse out through the same berth and lane; allow about a minute of travel in each direction.
payload_desc: Low fixture kit with locating blocks and fasteners
motion_rationale: A 0.247 m/s forward and reverse peak covers each 13.2 m leg in about one minute while allowing slower movement at the kit exchange berth.

title: Library Return Bin Express
description: Move a secured 19 kg book bin from the return desk to sorting along a 36 m straight staff corridor. The four-module body makes the forward run in about 145 seconds, with no sideways movement or turns. After unloading, reverse the empty bin along the same unobstructed route.
payload_desc: Low return bin containing books
motion_rationale: Forward and reverse peaks of 0.258 m/s provide the sustained pace needed for 36 m legs of about 145 seconds including gentle starts and stops.

title: Laboratory Sample Carrier Circuit
description: Carry a secured insulated sample carrier on a 2x3 body through a laboratory's level transfer room. Go forward 9 m, turn 90 degrees counter-clockwise in a 1.5 m clear square, and move 2 m diagonally front-left around a fixed bench corner. Slide right 0.4 m into the receiving position, then reverse 0.8 m after staff unload the carrier.
payload_desc: Insulated carrier with sealed sample racks and cooling packs
motion_rationale: A 0.167 m/s surge peak supports a one-minute main leg and slower reverse clearance, 0.112 m/s gives a roughly 20-second diagonal, 0.038 m/s permits a 12-second side placement, and 17 deg/s gives a gentle seven-second quarter-turn.

title: Backroom Cosmetics Cubby Restock
description: Carry a 4.3 kg cosmetics carton into a 2.6 m dead-end backroom aisle between storage cages. The single module approaches forward, stops for staff to lift the carton, then reverses to the entrance because it cannot turn beneath the projecting shelves. Allow about 20 seconds for each travel leg.
payload_desc: Closed carton of boxed cosmetics secured to the deck
motion_rationale: Forward and reverse peaks of 0.149 m/s allow approximately 20 seconds per 2.6 m leg with slow entry and stopping beneath the shelves.

title: Interior Slab Survey Kit Delivery
description: Deliver an 11 kg survey kit across a cured, level indoor construction slab on a three-module strip body. Travel forward 7 m, move 3.2 m diagonally front-right through a cleared gap between material stacks, then turn 90 degrees clockwise in an open work square. Slide left 0.7 m alongside the survey station for unloading.
payload_desc: Survey instrument case and compact accessory box
motion_rationale: A 0.191 m/s forward peak fits the 7 m leg into about 40 seconds, 0.179 m/s covers the diagonal in about 20 seconds, 28 deg/s permits a five-second quarter-turn, and 0.076 m/s gives about 10 seconds for the side placement.

title: Studio Camera Dolly Reset
description: Carry a 2.8 kg compact camera rig on a three-module dolly across a level studio floor. Between takes, move 12 m diagonally rear-right to the next floor mark within 49 seconds without changing the camera heading. During the take, slide left 2 m over about 38 seconds for a slow tracking shot.
payload_desc: Compact camera, low mount, and battery
motion_rationale: The 49-second 12 m diagonal reset needs a near-full 0.266 m/s peak, while a 0.056 m/s leftward peak supports the slow 38-second tracking shot with gentle acceleration.

title: Museum Label Supply Traverse
description: Carry a 2.2 kg tray of replacement labels and mounting supplies along a 42 m straight museum gallery after closing. Drive forward to the conservator's worktable in about three minutes, keeping clear of exhibit plinths. After unloading, reverse along the same line without turning near the exhibits.
payload_desc: Replacement labels, adhesive tabs, and small hand tools
motion_rationale: Forward and reverse peaks of 0.241 m/s cover the 42 m gallery legs in about three minutes each while allowing gentle starts and stops near exhibits.

title: Blind Picking Aisle Retrieval
description: Take an empty tote forward 9 m into a narrow blind picking aisle on a four-module square body. A picker loads 15.8 kg of small boxed parts at the end rack, then the body reverses all the way to the cross-aisle without turning. Once fully clear, slide right 0.8 m to the takeaway station.
payload_desc: Picking tote with boxed bearings and fittings
motion_rationale: Forward and reverse peaks of 0.187 m/s allow roughly 52 seconds per 9 m aisle leg, and a 0.091 m/s rightward peak gives about 10 seconds for the 0.8 m takeaway placement.

title: Cross Dock Mini Pallet Shuttle
description: Carry an 18 kg combined load of goods and a 0.4 m square mini pallet between two floor-level cross-dock handoff stands. Travel forward 10 m, turn 90 degrees clockwise in a clear intersection, then move 2.4 m diagonally front-left into the receiving lane. Slide right 0.35 m for the final handoff alignment; this job uses no full-size pallets.
payload_desc: Small goods stack and lightweight 0.4 m square mini pallet
motion_rationale: A 0.239 m/s forward peak fits the 10 m crossing into about 45 seconds, 0.194 m/s covers the diagonal in about 14 seconds, 31 deg/s permits a four-second quarter-turn, and 0.041 m/s supports a 10-second final side alignment.

title: Dense Hardware Tote Transfer
description: Transfer a 19.6 kg tote of metal fasteners from a low shelf handoff to a packing station 8 m away. The four-module body carries the tote forward along a straight aisle, allowing about 55 seconds for loaded transit. Slide left 0.45 m at the station to place the tote beside the operator without rotating it.
payload_desc: Reinforced tote of bagged metal fasteners
motion_rationale: A 0.161 m/s forward peak supports the 55-second loaded 8 m transit, while 0.039 m/s leftward motion allows about 13 seconds for careful placement of the heavy tote.

title: Rack Inventory Scanner Sprint
description: Carry a 1.3 kg barcode camera on a two-module body through a 27 m rack aisle during a reserved inventory window. Drive forward past the rack labels in about 108 seconds, then slide left 0.9 m across the clear end bay to the adjacent aisle. Reverse down that aisle while the camera records the opposite rack face.
payload_desc: Low barcode camera and compact recorder
motion_rationale: Near-full forward and reverse peaks of 0.263 m/s support 108-second scanning passes over 27 m, and a 0.151 m/s leftward peak allows an approximately eight-second aisle change.

title: Level Trailer Carton Extraction
description: Enter a stationary trailer through a flush horizontal bridge plate and travel forward 18 m from the indoor receiving point to the loading position. Staff secure a 17 kg carton bundle to the four-module deck, then the body reverses the full route in about 80 seconds. The trailer floor and dock are at equal height, and the straight path requires no turns.
payload_desc: Strapped bundle of small cartons within the deck footprint
motion_rationale: Forward and reverse peaks of 0.243 m/s cover each straight 18 m route in about 80 seconds while allowing a slow crossing of the flush bridge plate.

title: Cold Store Offset Dock Approach
description: Carry a 12.2 kg insulated food tote forward 7 m through a cold-storage aisle on a three-module strip body. At the clear aisle end, approach the receiving dock along a 1.2 m front-right diagonal while keeping the tote label facing forward. Allow about 18 seconds for that approach, then retreat diagonally rear-left after unloading.
payload_desc: Lidded insulated tote of packaged chilled food
motion_rationale: A 0.183 m/s forward peak fits the 7 m aisle transit into about 42 seconds, while 0.078 m/s diagonal peaks permit approximately 18-second dock approaches and matching retreats.

title: Mezzanine Conveyor Tray Alignment
description: Carry a 9.7 kg parts tray along 5 m of level mezzanine floor to a stopped low conveyor handoff. In the guarded docking pocket, turn three degrees clockwise to square the tray, then slide left 0.12 m over about 10 seconds and creep forward the final 0.18 m over about 12 seconds. Staff transfer the tray once the alignment marks match; the robot stays on this mezzanine throughout.
payload_desc: Low parts tray with locating edges
motion_rationale: The 5 m transit needs a 0.132 m/s forward peak before slowing to roughly 0.018 m/s for final creep, while 0.015 m/s leftward and 0.8 deg/s clockwise peaks provide the specified small alignment corrections.

title: Returned Glassware Inspection Transfer
description: Carry an 8.4 kg divided crate of returned glassware from intake to the inspection bench on a four-module body. Move forward 6 m over about 65 seconds, then travel 1 m diagonally rear-right around a taped exclusion corner without rotating the crate. Slide left 0.25 m into the padded receiving position over about 12 seconds.
payload_desc: Padded divided crate of returned drinking glasses
motion_rationale: A gentle 0.103 m/s forward peak supports the 65-second main leg, 0.063 m/s gives about 18 seconds for the rear-right diagonal, and 0.024 m/s allows the delicate 12-second side placement.

title: Mobile Rack Sensor Retrieval
description: Send a two-module body lengthwise into an opened mobile-rack aisle to collect a 6.3 kg sensor tote from a floor-level handoff. Travel forward 4 m through the 0.28 m gap, then slide right 0.025 m to center beneath the handoff guide without turning. After loading, slide left back to the aisle center and reverse out before the rack interlock is released.
payload_desc: Narrow sensor tote supported along the two-module deck
motion_rationale: Forward and reverse peaks of 0.107 m/s allow roughly 42 seconds per constrained 4 m leg, and 0.006 m/s lateral peaks spread each 25 mm centering correction over about six seconds.

title: Pharmacy Tote Diagonal Docking
description: Carry a 10.8 kg sealed medicine tote forward 8 m from picking to the verification cell on a four-module square body. The receiving dock is offset left behind a bench end, so approach along a marked 0.85 m front-left diagonal without changing the tote's heading. Allow about 15 seconds for the diagonal docking movement, then retreat rear-right after the technician removes the tote.
payload_desc: Sealed tote of boxed medicines for verification
motion_rationale: A 0.198 m/s forward peak supports an approximately 44-second 8 m transit, while 0.066 m/s diagonal peaks allow gentle 15-second docking and retreat movements over the offset 0.85 m path.

title: Retrieve Fasteners From Blind Aisles
description: Carry a 12 kg fastener tote from a blind picking aisle to the packing bench using three modules docked in a 0.6 by 0.2 m line. The 6 m aisle allows forward entry and reverse withdrawal but has no turning space; allow 40 seconds of steady travel in each direction. At the aisle mouth, slide left 0.3 m over 6 seconds to meet the bench.
payload_desc: Lidded fastener tote
motion_rationale: Forward entry and reverse withdrawal need 0.15 m/s for each 6 m cruising leg in 40 seconds, while the 0.3 m left slide takes 6 seconds at 0.05 m/s.

title: Shuttle Mini Pallets Across Dock
description: Move a 28 kg mini pallet of boxed connectors between two floor-level cross-dock stands on a six-module 0.6 by 0.4 m body. The route includes a 10 m forward crossing with a 40-second cruising allowance, a 1.5 m front-right diagonal through a marked gap in 10 seconds, and a clockwise 90-degree turn in place over 3 seconds. Slide right 0.4 m over 8 seconds to align with the receiving stand.
payload_desc: Deck-sized mini pallet of boxed connectors
motion_rationale: The crossing requires 0.25 m/s, the 1.5 m diagonal requires 0.15 m/s, the final right slide requires 0.05 m/s, and the clockwise quarter-turn requires 30 deg/s during their stated cruising intervals.

title: Transfer Totes Beside Guard Rails
description: Move an 8 kg tote from a shelf pickup pad to a packing station with a two-module body oriented 0.4 m along the aisle. Travel forward along the 4 m rail corridor with 25 seconds of steady travel. Keep the same heading while sliding right 0.18 m into the station over 9 seconds, then slide left to clear the receiving lip.

constraints: Lateral transfer occurs in station recess

payload_desc: Narrow tote of bagged components
motion_rationale: The 4 m cruising leg uses 0.16 m/s for 25 seconds, and the close-clearance lateral insertion and withdrawal use 0.02 m/s for each 0.18 m movement.

title: Scan Labels Along Reserve Racks
description: Carry a 2.4 kg low-mounted label scanner on a six-module 0.6 by 0.4 m body along a 26 m reserve-rack lane. The scan schedule allows 100 seconds of steady forward travel, requiring nearly full transit speed. At the open end, turn counter-clockwise through 180 degrees over 6 seconds and scan the opposite rack on the return pass.

constraints: Rack lane closed to picking traffic

payload_desc: Low-mounted label scanner and battery
motion_rationale: Each 26 m scan pass needs 0.26 m/s over its 100-second cruising window, and the six-module body makes its 180-degree counter-clockwise turn at 30 deg/s.

title: Unload Dense Parts From Trailer
description: Carry a strapped 10 kg case of machine parts from a trailer's flat interior to a receiving pad using two modules. The dock leveler is locked flush with the trailer, and a continuous steel bridge covers the joint without a step. Drive forward 7.2 m with 40 seconds of steady travel, then slide left 0.24 m over 8 seconds at the receiving pad.
payload_desc: Strapped case of dense machine parts
motion_rationale: The loaded 7.2 m forward leg uses 0.18 m/s over 40 cruising seconds, while the 0.24 m receiving alignment uses a restrained 0.03 m/s left slide.

title: Rush Samples Through Cold Storage
description: Take a 1.6 kg insulated sample box from a freezer staging pad to the internal quality hatch on a two-module body. The dry, straight aisle provides a 13 m forward leg with 50 seconds of steady travel to limit cold exposure. Keep the box facing the hatch and slide right 0.3 m over 5 seconds for handoff.
payload_desc: Insulated box containing sealed food samples
motion_rationale: The exposure-limited 13 m aisle run requires 0.26 m/s during 50 cruising seconds, and the 0.3 m rightward hatch approach takes 5 seconds at 0.06 m/s.

title: Feed Motor Kits To Conveyor
description: Carry a 20 kg tray of motor kits from the mezzanine assembly bench to a stopped conveyor loading pad on a four-module square body. Both points are on the same flat mezzanine, separated by an 8.4 m lane with 60 seconds of steady forward travel. At the fenced loading bay, turn clockwise 90 degrees over 6 seconds and slide left 0.2 m over 10 seconds to present the tray.

constraints: Tray load distributed across four decks

payload_desc: Restrained tray of motor assembly kits
motion_rationale: The full-load lane run needs 0.14 m/s for 8.4 m in 60 cruising seconds, followed by a 15 deg/s clockwise turn and 0.02 m/s lateral presentation.

title: Move Returned Battery Tool Cases
description: Move a 9.5 kg secured tool case from returns intake to the electrical inspection table on a two-module body. Cross the open sorting square diagonally front-left for 3.6 m with 30 seconds of steady travel, keeping the case handle facing the inspector. Slide right 0.4 m over 10 seconds into the table recess and reverse 1.2 m over 12 seconds after unloading.

constraints: Inspection recess has no turning space

payload_desc: Latched returned battery tool case
motion_rationale: The loaded diagonal uses 0.12 m/s for 3.6 m in 30 cruising seconds, table insertion uses 0.04 m/s sideways, and unloaded reverse clearance uses 0.1 m/s.

title: Align Tray With Mobile Racking
description: Bring a 6 kg stock tray into the locked-open channel of a mobile rack using three modules in a 0.6 by 0.2 m line. Advance 2.4 m with 30 seconds of steady travel, then use the widened end pocket to correct heading clockwise by 4 degrees over 4 seconds. Slide left 0.06 m over 6 seconds and creep forward the final 0.12 m over 12 seconds to align the tray with the pickup fixture.

constraints: Heading correction only in end pocket

payload_desc: Stock tray with molded locating features
motion_rationale: Forward travel peaks at 0.08 m/s before slowing to 0.01 m/s at the fixture, while the 60 mm lateral correction needs 0.01 m/s and the four-degree heading correction needs 1 deg/s.

title: Deliver Pharmacy Cell Cassettes
description: Carry a 2.2 kg sealed prescription cassette between two guarded dispensers using one module. Follow the 2.1 m channel forward with 30 seconds of steady travel; its 0.26 m width leaves little room beside the cassette. At the receiving pocket, slide right 0.08 m over 8 seconds, then reverse along the channel after the cassette is removed.
payload_desc: Sealed prescription cassette
motion_rationale: Channel entry and reverse exit peak at 0.07 m/s for the 2.1 m legs, while the closely guarded 80 mm right slide takes 8 seconds at 0.01 m/s.

title: Search Cleared Collapsed Corridor
description: Send a four-module square body carrying a 1.8 kg camera and listening unit from the incident doorway to a search position beyond a damaged partition. Responders have cleared a flat 12.5 m corridor strip, allowing 50 seconds of steady forward travel. At the clear end pocket, move diagonally front-left 1 m over 10 seconds to look around the partition without touching debris.
payload_desc: Camera, microphone, and listening unit
motion_rationale: The cleared 12.5 m approach needs 0.25 m/s over 50 cruising seconds, while the final one-meter diagonal observation approach slows to 0.1 m/s.

title: Check Offices Through Smoke
description: Carry a 1.2 kg thermal camera and gas sensor along a smoke-filled office corridor on three modules arranged in a line. A previously surveyed 10.4 m carpeted lane has a 40-second steady-travel allowance before the first office. In the clear lobby, turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees over 3 seconds, then slide left 0.6 m over 10 seconds to view through the doorway.

constraints: Route cleared of cables and furniture

payload_desc: Thermal camera and gas sensor
motion_rationale: The urgent 10.4 m corridor run needs 0.26 m/s during 40 cruising seconds, followed by a 30 deg/s lobby turn and 0.06 m/s lateral doorway approach.

title: Survey Garage Debris Perimeter
description: Take a 0.9 kg inspection camera to a marked observation point beside fallen garage panels using two modules. The route follows a swept, level strip through the debris field, including a 6.5 m front-right diagonal with 25 seconds of steady travel. Reverse 2 m along a straight cleared spur with 10 seconds of steady travel to inspect the back of a parked vehicle.

constraints: No rubble or loose gravel on route
Remain on one level parking slab

payload_desc: Low-profile inspection camera
motion_rationale: The unobstructed 6.5 m diagonal requires 0.26 m/s over 25 cruising seconds, while the straight reverse inspection leg uses 0.2 m/s for 2 m in 10 seconds.

title: Probe Flooded Basement Dead Ends
description: Use a four-module square body to carry a 2 kg water-depth probe and camera down two blind basement passages. Each passage has a 3 m forward approach and reverse withdrawal with 50 seconds of steady travel per leg because a thin layer of water hides the floor markings. Between passages, slide right 0.8 m over 20 seconds across the flat connecting bay without turning.

constraints: Floor surveyed for holes and debris

payload_desc: Water-depth probe and waterproof camera
motion_rationale: The wet blind passages limit forward and reverse travel to 0.06 m/s for each 3 m leg, and the 0.8 m connecting slide takes 20 seconds at 0.04 m/s.

title: Inspect Tunnel Cross Passages
description: Carry a 1.4 kg directional camera and crack light along the flat pedestrian strip of a quake-affected utility tunnel using two modules. Travel forward between three inspection pockets, covering 4.8 m between stops with 30 seconds of steady travel. At each pocket, turn in place 90 degrees clockwise to inspect a cross passage and 90 degrees counter-clockwise to resume, allowing 2 seconds per turn.

constraints: Tunnel strip cleared and structurally released
No rails or drainage channels crossed

payload_desc: Directional camera and crack illumination lamp
motion_rationale: The 4.8 m intervals require 0.16 m/s during 30 cruising seconds, and repeated two-second quarter-turns require 45 deg/s in both yaw directions.

title: Stage Evacuation Supplies At Bays
description: Deliver a 7 kg tray of evacuation masks and identification bands to three staffed refuge bays using three modules in a line. Move forward along 3 m corridor sections with 25 seconds of steady travel, stopping whenever a bed crosses the route. In each widened bay, turn in place 90 degrees toward the receiving nurse over 5 seconds and turn back after handoff, using both turning directions along the route.

constraints: Turns restricted to widened refuge bays

payload_desc: Tray of evacuation masks and identification bands
motion_rationale: The shared corridor calls for 0.12 m/s over each 3 m cruising section, while five-second quarter-turns keep supply presentation controlled at 18 deg/s.

title: Carry Samples Across Stair Landing
description: Move a 1.1 kg padded carrier of glass air-sampling vials from the landing door to a responder's collection pad using one module. Stay entirely on the flat landing, advancing 1.2 m with 30 seconds of steady travel before sliding left 0.3 m over 15 seconds around the door swing. Keep the carrier heading fixed and use gentle starts to protect the vials.
payload_desc: Padded carrier of sealed glass air-sampling vials
motion_rationale: The fragile carrier travels forward at 0.04 m/s for the 1.2 m landing crossing and sideways at 0.02 m/s for the 0.3 m door-clearance maneuver.

title: Map Warehouse Fire Residue
description: Carry a 2.5 kg residue-imaging unit down a released warehouse aisle using two modules. The swept aisle provides a 24 m straight run with 100 seconds of steady forward travel while the unit records floor discoloration. Keep the same heading and reverse the full length at the same cruising speed to compare the return images.

constraints: Loose ash removed from wheel path

payload_desc: Downward-facing residue-imaging unit
motion_rationale: Both 24 m imaging passes need 0.24 m/s over 100 cruising seconds, with reverse travel preserving the camera heading for comparison.

title: Deliver Glass Medical Cartridges
description: Move a 3 kg cushioned case of glass medication cartridges from one vestibule to a responder station inside a stationary train carriage using two modules. Follow the level aisle forward for 5.4 m with 90 seconds of steady travel, then slide right 0.24 m over 12 seconds into a cleared seat bay. Reverse 0.6 m over 15 seconds after handoff without turning near the seats.

constraints: Seat bay cleared for lateral entry

payload_desc: Cushioned case of sealed glass medication cartridges
motion_rationale: The fragile load limits forward cruising to 0.06 m/s, the 0.24 m seat-bay slide to 0.02 m/s, and the unloaded reverse maneuver remains below the surge peak at 0.04 m/s.

title: Dock Refuge Communications Battery
description: Carry a 6 kg communications battery to a floor-level docking cradle inside a mine refuge chamber using two modules. After a 2.4 m forward approach with 20 seconds of steady travel, approach the angled cradle diagonally front-left for 0.9 m over 30 seconds without changing heading. Once staff remove the battery, withdraw diagonally rear-right along the same line.
payload_desc: Secured communications battery pack
motion_rationale: The chamber approach needs 0.12 m/s for 2.4 m in 20 cruising seconds, while diagonal docking and withdrawal use 0.03 m/s to cover the 0.9 m alignment path in 30 seconds.

title: Measure Cold Aisle Airflow
description: Carry a 3.2 kg low-profile airflow instrument through a data-centre cold aisle on a four-module square body. Travel forward 9 m with 75 seconds of steady travel between rack-door edges. At each of two recessed measurement stations, slide left 0.1 m over 10 seconds toward the rack face and slide right to return to the aisle centerline without yawing.

constraints: Lateral moves only in recessed stations

payload_desc: Low-profile airflow and temperature instrument
motion_rationale: The 9 m rack run needs 0.12 m/s over 75 cruising seconds, while the tight measurement recesses require 0.01 m/s for each 0.1 m lateral movement.

title: Inspect Inverter Cabinet Seams
description: Move a 1.7 kg thermal camera along the service strip between inverter cabinets and a cable guard inside the inverter room using two modules in a line. Advance 3.6 m with 40 seconds of steady travel, keeping the camera pointed at the cabinet seams. At the widened inspection notch, slide right 0.12 m over 6 seconds and left again to change the viewing angle without turning.

constraints: Cable guard remains outside wheel path
Lateral movement restricted to inspection notch

payload_desc: Side-facing thermal camera and recorder
motion_rationale: The narrow 3.6 m service strip uses 0.09 m/s for 40 cruising seconds, and each 0.12 m lateral viewing adjustment takes 6 seconds at 0.02 m/s.

title: Inspect Beneath Wing Service Bay
description: Carry a 2.8 kg upward-facing camera and lamp beneath an aircraft wing on three modules arranged in a line. Enter a 4.2 m blind lane between service stands with 35 seconds of steady forward travel, stop for imaging, and reverse out with 42 seconds of steady travel because the rear clearances are harder to judge. Once clear of the stands, slide left 0.6 m over 10 seconds to reach the equipment collection pad.
payload_desc: Upward-facing inspection camera and lamp
motion_rationale: Forward entry sets the surge peak at 0.12 m/s, reverse withdrawal slows to 0.1 m/s, and the clear-area 0.6 m left slide takes 10 seconds at 0.06 m/s.

title: Record Engine Room Gauge Faces
description: Carry a 4.5 kg directional acoustic sensor and gauge camera between four machinery inspection pockets on a six-module 0.6 by 0.4 m body. Follow the level engine-room deck forward in 3.3 m sections with 30 seconds of steady travel. At each clear pocket, turn in place through 120 degrees over 4 seconds to face a gauge bank, then turn back, using clockwise and counter-clockwise yaw.

constraints: Ship secured alongside without appreciable roll
Deck dry and free of oil
Route avoids coamings and open gratings
Inspection pockets clear full turning envelope

payload_desc: Directional acoustic sensor and gauge-reading camera
motion_rationale: The machinery lanes require 0.11 m/s for each 3.3 m cruising section, while repeated 120-degree reorientations take 4 seconds at a six-module turning rate of 30 deg/s.

title: Survey Turbine Hall Bearing Stations
description: Carry a 7.5 kg vibration recorder and thermal camera between floor-level bearing inspection stations in the turbine hall on a six-module 0.6 by 0.4 m body. Travel forward 12 m with 50 seconds of steady travel, turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees over 3 seconds in a marked bay, and move diagonally front-right 2.4 m over 15 seconds around a fixed instrument pedestal. Slide left 0.2 m over 10 seconds for the reading, then reverse 1.2 m over 10 seconds to clear the station.

constraints: Route confined to released turbine hall floor
No hoses or cable covers crossed

payload_desc: Vibration recorder, thermal camera, and protected sensor leads
motion_rationale: The main run sets surge at 0.24 m/s with reverse clearance at 0.12 m/s, the pedestal diagonal needs 0.16 m/s, the close reading approach needs 0.02 m/s sideways, and the three-second quarter-turn needs 30 deg/s.

title: Cold Room Sample Docking
description: Carry a sealed food-sample tote down a 9 m cold-storage aisle with a 6 m cruise section covered in 30 seconds. At the open aisle end, approach the sampling dock diagonally front-right over 0.6 m in 8 seconds, then reverse straight out after unloading without turning.
payload_desc: Sealed insulated food-sample tote
motion_rationale: The straight cruise and reverse withdrawal need up to 0.2 m/s, while the 0.6 m front-right docking approach takes 8 seconds at 0.075 m/s.

title: Mezzanine Conveyor Label Feed
description: Move a cassette of label rolls between three conveyor feed stands on one level mezzanine. Cruise forward along each 1.8 m clear section in 12 seconds and turn in place 90 degrees in 3 seconds, clockwise at the second stand and counter-clockwise at the third; use the marked turning pads beside the guarded edge.
payload_desc: Cassette holding replacement label rolls
motion_rationale: Forward cruise sections require 1.8/12 = 0.15 m/s, and repeated clockwise and counter-clockwise quarter-turns require 90/3 = 30 deg/s.

title: Returns Bench Side Transfer
description: Take a tray of returned handheld scanners through the 0.28 m gap between sorting benches, with the two-module body arranged lengthwise. Cruise forward over the clear 2.4 m portion in 20 seconds, then slide left 0.18 m into a bench recess over 6 seconds; slide right out and reverse through the same gap after unloading.
payload_desc: Padded tray of returned handheld scanners
motion_rationale: Forward and reverse travel use a 0.12 m/s cruise through the narrow gap, while each 0.18 m lateral insertion or withdrawal takes 6 seconds at 0.03 m/s.

title: Mobile Rack Dead-End Retrieval
description: Enter a locked-open mobile-rack aisle to collect a boxed replacement drive at its dead end. Cover the middle 5.5 m forward in 25 seconds, creep the final 0.3 m at 0.025 m/s, and reverse out at the same 0.22 m/s cruise because the aisle has no turning pocket.
payload_desc: Boxed replacement conveyor drive
motion_rationale: Both entry and reverse exit need a 5.5/25 = 0.22 m/s peak cruise, with the final rack approach reduced to 0.025 m/s.

title: Pharmacy Tote Face Rotation
description: Carry a compartmented prescription tote around four checking stations, cruising forward across each 1.5 m transfer section in 10 seconds. At the stations, turn in place 90 degrees in 5 seconds in either direction to present the requested tote face, with one 180-degree turn taking 10 seconds inside the 0.7 m inspection square.
payload_desc: Compartmented tote of packaged prescriptions
motion_rationale: Station transfers require 1.5/10 = 0.15 m/s forward cruise, and both quarter-turns in 5 seconds and half-turns in 10 seconds require 18 deg/s.

title: Cleared Corridor Search Probe
description: Carry a low camera and microphone through a cleared strip of level corridor beside a collapsed partition, cruising forward 3.2 m in 20 seconds. Slide left 0.4 m over 8 seconds around a cabinet, move diagonally front-right 0.65 m over 10 seconds into a doorway, and turn clockwise 60 degrees over 6 seconds to inspect it before reversing along the cleared exit line.
payload_desc: Secured low camera, microphone, and battery pack
motion_rationale: The clear corridor supports 0.16 m/s forward and reverse cruise, while the cabinet offset, doorway diagonal, and inspection turn require 0.05 m/s, 0.065 m/s, and 10 deg/s respectively.

title: Office Air Sample Return
description: Bring a shock-mounted rack of sealed glass air-sampling tubes from a smoke-filled office to the collection station along a surveyed 14 m level route. Cruise forward over the clear 7.2 m portion in 60 seconds, slide right 0.3 m over 10 seconds beside the collection table, and reverse slowly out of its recess after the rack is lifted off.
payload_desc: Shock-mounted rack of sealed glass air-sampling tubes
motion_rationale: The fragile rack limits forward cruise to 7.2/60 = 0.12 m/s, reverse withdrawal stays below that peak, and the 0.3 m table offset takes 10 seconds at 0.03 m/s.

title: Garage Debris Perimeter Survey
description: Move a survey scanner and battery pack among four cleared pads around a parking-garage debris field without crossing rubble. Cruise forward across the 4.5 m clear sections in 25 seconds, then turn in place clockwise or counter-clockwise by 120 degrees in 8 seconds at each pad to aim the scanner at exposed voids.
payload_desc: Low-mounted survey scanner and secured battery pack
motion_rationale: Clear transfers require 4.5/25 = 0.18 m/s forward cruise, and the six-module body makes each 120-degree scanner reorientation in 8 seconds at 15 deg/s.

title: Basement Water Sensor Delivery
description: Deliver a lightweight water-level logger along a straight 22 m basement service aisle with a uniform 4 mm film of clean water on the flat floor. Use water-protected modules and cruise forward through the central 15.6 m in 60 seconds, then slow for the receiving stand and reverse along the same aisle after unloading.

constraints: verified traction and no hidden openings

payload_desc: Water-level logger in a sealed case
motion_rationale: The unobstructed, traction-checked aisle requires 15.6/60 = 0.26 m/s forward and reverse cruise, with slower travel near the receiving stand.

title: Tunnel Joint Camera Sweep
description: Carry a directional crack camera along a cleared, level tunnel service strip after a quake, cruising forward across 6 m sections in 30 seconds. Stop at six marked joints and turn in place 90 degrees in 4 seconds to inspect one wall, then counter-rotate 180 degrees in 8 seconds to inspect the other before restoring the travel heading.
payload_desc: Directional crack camera with lighting and recorder
motion_rationale: The tunnel transfers require 6/30 = 0.2 m/s forward cruise, while the alternating 90- and 180-degree wall views require 22.5 deg/s in both yaw directions.

title: Evacuation Supply Alcove Shuttle
description: Carry sealed dressings and blankets from a hospital supply point to an evacuation staging alcove, cruising forward through a protected 9 m corridor section in 45 seconds. Slide right 0.6 m over 8 seconds to clear a parked bed, go diagonally front-left 0.9 m over 10 seconds into the wider junction, and turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees in 6 seconds before reversing into the receiving alcove.
payload_desc: Secured tote of sealed dressings and folded blankets
motion_rationale: The corridor needs 0.2 m/s forward cruise with slower reverse docking, while the bed offset, junction diagonal, and quarter-turn require 0.075 m/s, 0.09 m/s, and 15 deg/s.

title: Landing Communications Kit Placement
description: Move a communications kit from the fire door to a receiving mat on a single 2.4 m square stairwell landing, staying entirely on its flat section. Advance 0.8 m over 10 seconds, slide left 0.35 m over 7 seconds, turn clockwise 45 degrees over 5 seconds, and reverse 0.4 m onto the mat over 5 seconds.
payload_desc: Secured communications kit and spare radio batteries
motion_rationale: The measured forward and reverse placement legs need 0.08 m/s, the 0.35 m left slide takes 7 seconds at 0.05 m/s, and the clockwise 45-degree turn takes 5 seconds at 9 deg/s.

title: Fire Aftermath Equipment Run
description: Carry a sealed atmosphere-monitoring kit and spare batteries down a cleared 42 m warehouse aisle after the fire crew releases the route. Cruise forward across the central 31.2 m in 120 seconds, stop for handoff at the far end, and reverse back along the same straight aisle because the receiving bay is blocked beyond the handoff point.
payload_desc: Sealed atmosphere-monitoring kit and spare battery cases
motion_rationale: The long cleared aisle needs 31.2/120 = 0.26 m/s cruise on both the loaded forward run and the empty reverse return.

title: Carriage Sample Cradle Transfer
description: Carry a padded cradle of glass exposure-sample vials from the middle of a stationary train carriage to its vestibule collection table. Cruise forward along the flush 5.4 m aisle section in 45 seconds, slide left 0.24 m over 8 seconds inside the vestibule, and reverse 0.36 m over 6 seconds to place the cradle under the table lift.
payload_desc: Padded cradle containing sealed glass exposure-sample vials
motion_rationale: The vial cradle travels forward at 5.4/45 = 0.12 m/s, its reverse placement is limited to 0.06 m/s, and the vestibule slide needs 0.24/8 = 0.03 m/s.

title: Refuge Chamber Filter Shuttle
description: Move replacement scrubber cartridges from the storage end of a mine refuge chamber to its service hatch along a straight 28 m finished-floor lane. Arrange the three modules in line, cruise forward through the central 19.2 m in 80 seconds, and reverse empty after the cartridges are removed because the hatch recess has no turning space.
payload_desc: Secured package of replacement scrubber cartridges
motion_rationale: The long straight chamber lane requires 19.2/80 = 0.24 m/s forward and reverse cruise, with slower entry into the hatch recess.

title: Cold Aisle Sensor Dock
description: Carry a compact temperature logger through a data-centre cold aisle, cruising forward along a 4.2 m rack section in 20 seconds. At the aisle end, move diagonally front-left 0.45 m over 9 seconds to meet the charging contacts without changing heading, then withdraw diagonally rear-right over the same path.
payload_desc: Compact temperature logger and low sensor mast
motion_rationale: Rack transit requires 4.2/20 = 0.21 m/s forward cruise, while both 0.45 m diagonal contact movements take 9 seconds at 0.05 m/s.

title: Inverter Cabinet Narrow Scan
description: Carry a thermal camera and recorder through the 0.3 m service gap behind inverter cabinets, using three modules in a straight line. Cruise forward along the clear 3.6 m section in 30 seconds, slide right 0.04 m over 4 seconds to establish the camera standoff at a recessed panel, then slide left and reverse out without turning.
payload_desc: Low thermal camera, recorder, and battery
motion_rationale: The narrow cabinet gap permits 3.6/30 = 0.12 m/s forward and reverse cruise, while each 40 mm camera-standoff adjustment takes 4 seconds at 0.01 m/s.

title: Wing Inspection Target Approach
description: Carry an upward-facing camera beneath a parked aircraft wing, cruising forward across a clear 5.5 m hangar section in 25 seconds. Approach the marked inspection target diagonally front-right along a 1.3 m line in 5 seconds, brake before the final 0.2 m alignment zone, and withdraw diagonally rear-left after imaging.
payload_desc: Upward-facing inspection camera and lighting cradle
motion_rationale: The clear hangar transfer needs 5.5/25 = 0.22 m/s forward cruise, and the front-right approach and rear-left withdrawal use up to 1.3/5 = 0.26 m/s before slowing for alignment.

title: Engine Room Analyzer Delivery
description: Carry an 18 kg vibration analyzer and magnetic probe kit across a level engine-room deck while the ship is secured alongside. Use a four-module square, cruise forward along the 3.3 m clear section in 30 seconds, then slide left 0.3 m over 10 seconds beside the pump skid and reverse out after the technician removes the kit.

constraints: no coamings or gratings on route

payload_desc: Secured vibration analyzer and magnetic probe kit
motion_rationale: The heavy kit uses four modules and a 3.3/30 = 0.11 m/s forward or reverse cruise, with a 0.3/10 = 0.03 m/s lateral placement beside the skid.

title: Turbine Optical Reference Transfer
description: Move a padded optical reference assembly from its cabinet to a turbine alignment station during a scheduled outage. With three modules in line, cruise forward over the clear 7.8 m floor section in 60 seconds, turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees over 15 seconds on a 0.9 m square pad, and slide right 0.2 m over 10 seconds beneath the receiving fixture.
payload_desc: Padded optical reference assembly in a rigid transport cradle
motion_rationale: The optical assembly needs 7.8/60 = 0.13 m/s forward cruise, a gentle 90/15 = 6 deg/s counter-clockwise turn, and a 0.2/10 = 0.02 m/s receiving slide.

title: Pipe Gallery Test Pack
description: Deliver an 18.8 kg ultrasonic inspection pack along a level pipe gallery to a technician working at a valve bank. Cruise forward through the 6.4 m unobstructed section in 40 seconds, shift diagonally front-left 0.72 m over 12 seconds into the wider valve bay, and reverse straight out after handoff without turning under the low pipes.

constraints: wider valve bay for diagonal move

payload_desc: Ultrasonic inspection pack with couplant and probe cases
motion_rationale: The loaded gallery run and empty reverse exit need up to 6.4/40 = 0.16 m/s, while the heavy pack enters the valve bay diagonally at 0.72/12 = 0.06 m/s.

title: Enclosed Bridge Optical Survey
description: Carry a fragile laser displacement sensor along the enclosed maintenance walkway beneath a bridge deck during a traffic closure. Cruise forward over the 8.4 m continuous steel section in 70 seconds, slide left 0.12 m over 6 seconds at a widened observation niche, then slide right and reverse back while keeping the sensor pointed toward the same girder.
payload_desc: Fragile laser displacement sensor on an isolation cradle
motion_rationale: The isolated optical sensor travels forward and backward at 8.4/70 = 0.12 m/s, with each 0.12 m niche adjustment taking 6 seconds at 0.02 m/s.

title: Nacelle Logger Express Shuttle
description: Move a small diagnostic logger between the rear service station and gearbox work position inside a parked wind-turbine nacelle. On the surveyed level floor lane, cruise forward through the clear 5.2 m section in 20 seconds, slide right 0.15 m over 3 seconds into the receiving recess, then slide left and reverse back after the logger is removed.
payload_desc: Small diagnostic logger in a secured padded case
motion_rationale: The light logger and clear nacelle lane permit 5.2/20 = 0.26 m/s forward and reverse cruise, while each 0.15 m recess slide takes 3 seconds at 0.05 m/s.

title: Cleanroom Particle Counter Circuit
description: Carry a low particle counter between three sampling points in a semiconductor cleanroom bay, using three modules in line and cruising forward over 3.6 m sections in 20 seconds. Slide left 0.3 m over 6 seconds beside the first tool, move diagonally rear-right 0.5 m over 10 seconds to clear its service envelope, then turn clockwise 90 degrees in 6 seconds on the marked 0.9 m pad and reverse into the final sampling position.
payload_desc: Low particle counter with secured sampling tubing
motion_rationale: Forward transfers need 0.18 m/s with slower reverse positioning, while the left slide and rear-right diagonal each need 0.05 m/s and the clockwise quarter-turn requires 15 deg/s.

title: Column Scanner Gentle Orbit
description: Carry a fragile structured-light scanner around one parking-structure column inside a closed, level survey bay, keeping the scanner face toward the column. Cruise forward 2.7 m to the first mark in 18 seconds, slide left 0.6 m over 12 seconds across its face, turn clockwise 90 degrees over 10 seconds at the clear corner, then advance to the next face and slide right at the same scan speed.

constraints: no drains or wheel stops on route

payload_desc: Fragile structured-light scanner in a padded low cradle
motion_rationale: The approach requires 2.7/18 = 0.15 m/s forward cruise, face scans use 0.6/12 = 0.05 m/s in either lateral direction, and the fragile scanner turns clockwise at 90/10 = 9 deg/s.

title: Rush Samples to the Analyzer
description: Carry a latched sample rack from accessioning to the analyzer along a clear vinyl corridor. Drive forward over the 6.5 m transit leg in a 25-second cruise window, then slide right 0.24 m over 8 seconds into the receiving position without turning.
payload_desc: Lidded rack of capped laboratory sample tubes
motion_rationale: The clear 6.5 m leg requires 0.26 m/s forward travel during its 25-second cruise window, while the 0.24 m receiving offset requires a gentle 0.03 m/s right slide over 8 seconds.

title: Restock the Blind Stockroom Bay
description: Carry a strapped carton of toiletries into a blind backroom aisle using a 2x2 body. Cover the 3.6 m approach in a 24-second cruise window, slide left 0.3 m over 10 seconds for unloading, then slide right and reverse the same aisle in a 30-second cruise window because there is no turning space.
payload_desc: Strapped carton of boxed toiletries
motion_rationale: The approach sets the 0.15 m/s surge peak, the reverse exit is slower at 0.12 m/s, and each 0.3 m unloading offset takes 10 seconds at 0.03 m/s sideways.

title: Deliver Anchors Behind Temporary Partitions
description: Move a secured box of anchor hardware down a swept, level slab corridor between temporary partitions using a 0.6 m long, 0.4 m wide body. Drive forward along the 5.4 m dead end in a 30-second cruise window, stop for unloading, and reverse out over a 45-second cruise window without turning.
payload_desc: Low secured box of anchor bolts and washers
motion_rationale: The unobstructed 5.4 m approach needs 0.18 m/s forward cruise, while the same-length reverse exit uses 0.12 m/s to preserve partition clearance.

title: Track a Tabletop Camera Shot
description: Carry a low camera cradle with a fragile macro lens across a smooth studio floor on a 2x2 body. Slide left for a 1.8 m tracking shot over 30 seconds, then move diagonally rear-right 0.72 m over 12 seconds to clear the set while keeping the lens pointed at the table. Use gentle acceleration ramps outside the constant-speed shot.
payload_desc: Compact camera, macro lens, and vibration-isolated cradle
motion_rationale: Both the 1.8 m sideways shot over 30 seconds and the 0.72 m rear-right clearance move over 12 seconds require a gentle 0.06 m/s peak.

title: Retrieve Gallery Lighting Equipment
description: Carry a padded case of portable gallery lights from an alcove to the after-hours service area using a 0.6 m long, 0.4 m wide body. Reverse 4.2 m out of the blind alcove in a 35-second cruise window, turn clockwise 90 degrees in the open gallery over 6 seconds, and drive forward 3.3 m in a 22-second cruise window.
payload_desc: Padded case containing portable LED gallery lights
