motion_rationale: The alcove exit uses 0.12 m/s reverse travel, the service-area leg sets a 0.15 m/s forward peak, and the open-gallery 90-degree turn takes 6 seconds at 15 deg/s.

title: Collect a Narrow Aisle Pick
description: Take a compact picking tote down a 0.46 m aisle on a 2x2 body, leaving only 0.03 m clearance on either side. Drive forward 4.8 m in a 40-second cruise window, then slide left 0.02 m over 4 seconds to meet the shelf transfer guide. Slide right to recenter and reverse out after the pick.
payload_desc: Compact tote of packaged electrical connectors
motion_rationale: The straight 4.8 m aisle permits 0.12 m/s forward and reverse cruise, while the 20 mm shelf alignment takes 4 seconds at only 0.005 m/s sideways.

title: Shuttle a Loaded Mini Pallet
description: Carry a 38 kg load on a lightweight 0.75 m by 0.45 m mini pallet supported by an eight-module body arranged four long and two wide. Cross the level cross-dock forward for 7.2 m in a 40-second cruise window, then slide right 0.6 m over 12 seconds into a marked unloading pocket without rotating the pallet.
payload_desc: Lightweight mini pallet and strapped cartons of metal fittings
motion_rationale: The heavy mini pallet crosses 7.2 m at 0.18 m/s during its 40-second cruise window and enters the unloading pocket with a 0.6 m right slide at 0.05 m/s.

title: Align Tote With Transfer Fingers
description: Bring a tote from a shelf pickup point to a packing station using a 2x2 body. Drive forward 2.8 m in a 20-second cruise window, turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees over 10 seconds in the station apron, and slide left through the final 0.12 m over 12 seconds to align the tote with transfer fingers.
payload_desc: Tote of bagged fasteners with a locating base
motion_rationale: The 2.8 m transit needs 0.14 m/s surge, the 90-degree apron turn uses 9 deg/s over 10 seconds, and the 0.12 m transfer alignment requires 0.01 m/s lateral travel.

title: Scan Two Rack Faces
description: Carry a short barcode scanner mast along two parallel rack faces using a two-module body. Drive forward along each 10.4 m scan leg in a 40-second cruise window, using strobed barcode capture while moving. At the wide aisle end, turn clockwise 180 degrees over 4 seconds and slide right 0.9 m over 6 seconds to enter the return scan lane.
payload_desc: Short barcode scanner mast and controller
motion_rationale: Each 10.4 m scan leg needs 0.26 m/s forward cruise, while the clear apron allows a 45 deg/s half-turn and a 0.9 m right shift at 0.15 m/s.

title: Unload Lightweight Trailer Cartons
description: Carry a secured bundle of empty display cartons from a trailer to the receiving bench on a 2x2 body. Drive forward 8.1 m in a 30-second cruise window across a flush, locked dock bridge, then go diagonally front-left 1.3 m over 10 seconds to the bench. Reverse over the same diagonal and straight route after unloading.
payload_desc: Strapped bundle of flat-packed cardboard displays
motion_rationale: The clear 8.1 m trailer route needs full 0.27 m/s straight cruise, while each 1.3 m diagonal bench connection takes 10 seconds at 0.13 m/s.

title: Run Samples Through Cold Storage
description: Carry a sealed food-quality sample box from the cold-room entrance to a technician at the far end of a straight aisle. Drive forward along the 15.6 m aisle in a 60-second cruise window, then reverse the same route after handoff because the end has no turning apron.
payload_desc: Sealed insulated box of food-quality samples
motion_rationale: Both 15.6 m straight legs use 0.26 m/s cruise within 60-second travel windows, with no lateral movement or turning needed.

title: Feed the Mezzanine Conveyor
description: Carry a tote from a staging pad to a conveyor on the same level mezzanine using a 2x2 body. Drive forward 3.8 m in a 20-second cruise window, turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees over 5 seconds in a guarded apron, and move diagonally front-right 0.96 m over 8 seconds around a column. Slide left 0.18 m over 9 seconds for handoff, then reverse 0.4 m over 5 seconds to clear the conveyor.
payload_desc: Closed tote of packaged conveyor feed stock
motion_rationale: The main leg sets 0.19 m/s surge with slower 0.08 m/s reverse clearance, while the specified apron turn, diagonal bypass, and final slide require 18 deg/s, 0.12 m/s, and 0.02 m/s respectively.

title: Collect Returns From Sorting Nook
description: Carry a tray of returned handheld scanners out of a blind sorting nook with a two-module body oriented lengthwise. Reverse 2.7 m in an 18-second cruise window, slide right 0.56 m over 8 seconds across the open mouth, and drive forward 2.2 m in an 11-second cruise window to the testing desk.
payload_desc: Padded tray of returned handheld barcode scanners
motion_rationale: The nook exit uses 0.15 m/s reverse cruise, the testing-desk leg sets a 0.2 m/s forward peak, and the 0.56 m right shift takes 8 seconds at 0.07 m/s.

title: Reorient Between Mobile Rack Bays
description: Carry a small RFID reader through three inspection positions in an open mobile-rack aisle using a two-module body. Advance 1.44 m between positions in 8-second cruise windows, then turn in place 90 degrees over 2 seconds to face each rack and turn back before continuing. Finish with a 0.32 m left slide over 4 seconds onto the return marker.
payload_desc: Low-mounted RFID reader and antenna bracket
motion_rationale: The 1.44 m inter-position legs need 0.18 m/s forward cruise, repeated two-second quarter-turns require 45 deg/s in both directions, and the final left slide uses 0.08 m/s.

title: Route Prescriptions Through Verification
description: Carry a locked prescription tray between dispensing and verification on a two-module body. Drive forward 2.3 m in a 10-second cruise window, move diagonally front-left 0.84 m over 7 seconds through the open cell center, and turn clockwise 90 degrees over 6 seconds at verification. Slide right 0.08 m over 8 seconds into the tray guide, then reverse 0.3 m over 5 seconds after handoff.
payload_desc: Locked tray of individually packaged prescriptions
motion_rationale: The transit leg sets 0.23 m/s surge with a slower 0.06 m/s reverse release, while the diagonal crossing, quarter-turn, and precise guide entry require 0.12 m/s, 15 deg/s, and 0.01 m/s.

title: Search a Cleared Corridor Slot
description: Carry a low thermal camera through a cleared strip between fallen wall panels on a 2x2 body. The remaining passage is 0.48 m wide, so drive forward 3.15 m in a 45-second cruise window without turning. At a surveyed wider pocket, slide left 0.06 m over 6 seconds to look behind a panel, slide back, and reverse to the entry team.

constraints: lateral move only in wider pocket

payload_desc: Low thermal camera and task light
motion_rationale: The confined 3.15 m search leg and reverse exit use 0.07 m/s cruise, while the 0.06 m viewing offset takes 6 seconds at 0.01 m/s sideways.

title: Deliver Radio Through Smoky Offices
description: Carry a sealed two-way radio to a marked responder position on a surveyed, cool office floor using a two-module body. Drive forward 3.2 m in a 20-second cruise window, slide right 0.45 m over 9 seconds past a desk end, then turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees over 6 seconds in the copier alcove. Go diagonally front-left 0.9 m over 10 seconds to the handoff marker and reverse 0.4 m over 5 seconds to leave room.
payload_desc: Sealed responder radio and spare battery
motion_rationale: The corridor needs 0.16 m/s forward cruise with 0.08 m/s reverse clearance, while the desk bypass, alcove turn, and diagonal handoff approach require 0.05 m/s, 15 deg/s, and 0.09 m/s.

title: Dock Supplies Beside Garage Debris
description: Carry a medical supply box to a marked transfer dock beside a garage search team using a two-module body. Follow a swept, flat path forward for 4.2 m in a 30-second cruise window, then approach diagonally front-right along a 1.08 m clear strip over 12 seconds between two debris piles. Keep the box facing forward and reverse diagonally rear-left after the handoff.

constraints: no ramps or broken slab edges

payload_desc: Secured box of dressings, gloves, and compact medical supplies
motion_rationale: The swept 4.2 m approach needs 0.14 m/s forward cruise, and the 1.08 m diagonal docking strip is traversed in either direction at 0.09 m/s over 12 seconds.

title: Bring a Radio to Basement Dock
description: Carry a waterproof radio case across a flat basement floor with a surveyed 3 mm film of water, using a module approved for that water depth. Drive forward 1.8 m in a 30-second cruise window, then go diagonally front-left 0.48 m over 12 seconds to a floor-level transfer marker beside the pump operator. Reverse diagonally rear-right after collection without turning near the pump hose.
payload_desc: Waterproof case containing a two-way radio
motion_rationale: The wet 1.8 m straight leg is limited to 0.06 m/s over 30 seconds, and the 0.48 m diagonal docking and withdrawal moves use 0.04 m/s over 12 seconds each.

title: Align Camera With Tunnel Gauge
description: Carry a close-focus inspection camera to a temporary crack gauge on the intact, level tunnel service walkway using a two-module body. Drive forward 5.5 m in a 50-second cruise window, turn counter-clockwise 12 degrees over 6 seconds in a widened inspection recess, then slide left 0.045 m over 9 seconds to align the camera with the gauge. Hold position for the engineer's image capture.
payload_desc: Close-focus camera and low lighting bracket
motion_rationale: The 5.5 m transit uses 0.11 m/s forward cruise, while the 12-degree camera correction takes 6 seconds at 2 deg/s and the 45 mm lateral alignment takes 9 seconds at 0.005 m/s.

title: Dock Evacuation Supplies Beside Beds
description: Carry a compact evacuation supply kit to a nurse's transfer marker beside a bed staging area using a two-module body. Drive forward along a reserved 6 m corridor segment in a 25-second cruise window, then go diagonally front-right 0.84 m over 12 seconds into the marked gap between parked beds. Keep the kit facing the nurse and withdraw diagonally rear-left after unloading.
payload_desc: Compact kit of evacuation tags, gloves, and folded blankets
motion_rationale: The reserved 6 m corridor supports 0.24 m/s forward cruise, while the 0.84 m diagonal approach and withdrawal each use 0.07 m/s over 12 seconds beside the beds.

title: Position Landing Camera at Door
description: Carry a small camera to a door undercut on a flat stairwell landing, starting and finishing on that landing. Drive forward 0.72 m over a 12-second cruise window, turn clockwise 8 degrees over 4 seconds, and slide right 0.024 m over 6 seconds to line up the lens. After inspection, slide left, undo the turn, and reverse to the starting marker without approaching the stair edge.
payload_desc: Small low-mounted camera and LED light
motion_rationale: The short landing transit uses 0.06 m/s forward and reverse cruise, while reversible 8-degree heading corrections and 24 mm lateral adjustments require 2 deg/s and 0.004 m/s respectively.

title: Deliver Sensors Down Cleared Aisle
description: Carry a secured air-sampling kit from the entry control point to an assessor at the end of a cleared warehouse aisle using a 2x2 body. Travel forward along the 18 m straight run in a 75-second cruise window, wait for the kit to be removed, and reverse along the same marked path. The aisle has been swept after the fire and has no hot spots or standing water.
payload_desc: Secured air-sampling pump, sensor pack, and collection tubes
motion_rationale: The cleared 18 m aisle requires 0.24 m/s forward and reverse cruise to complete each long leg within its 75-second travel window.

title: Carry First Aid Through Carriage
description: Carry a first-aid pouch through a stationary, level train carriage using a two-module body oriented lengthwise along the aisle. Drive forward 4.8 m in a 40-second cruise window, slide left 0.24 m over 6 seconds into an open wheelchair bay, and turn clockwise 90 degrees over 5 seconds inside the bay. Move diagonally front-right 0.56 m over 8 seconds to the responder's marker, then reverse 0.3 m over 5 seconds after handoff.
payload_desc: Secured first-aid pouch with dressings and splints
motion_rationale: The carriage aisle needs 0.12 m/s forward cruise with 0.06 m/s reverse clearance, while entry into the bay, its quarter-turn, and the diagonal handoff require 0.04 m/s, 18 deg/s, and 0.07 m/s.

title: Supply the Refuge Chamber Bench
description: Carry a low crate of drinking-water pouches and radio batteries from inside the refuge chamber entrance to its supply bench on a 2x2 body. Drive forward 3.6 m in a 45-second cruise window through a 0.47 m gap between fixed lockers, keeping the crate inside the deck edges. At the wider bench recess, slide right 0.15 m over 10 seconds for unloading, slide left to recenter, and reverse out without turning.

constraints: sideways motion only in bench recess

payload_desc: Low secured crate of water pouches and sealed radio batteries
motion_rationale: The 3.6 m locker passage uses 0.08 m/s forward and reverse cruise to preserve its 35 mm side clearances, while each 0.15 m bench offset takes 10 seconds at 0.015 m/s sideways.

title: Sterile Packs Through Ward Stores
description: Carry a secured 24 kg tote of sterile packs from the hospital supply lift to the ward store using a 2x3 body. Travel forward along the 12 m corridor at a pace covering each clear 3 m section in 15 seconds, then slide right through a 0.46 m gap without changing heading. The final 0.30 m sideways insertion takes 10 seconds because the tote passes close to a cabinet handle.
payload_desc: Secured tote of sterile dressing packs
motion_rationale: Forward travel needs 0.20 m/s to cover clear 3 m sections in 15 seconds, while the tight rightward insertion limits sway to 0.03 m/s over its 0.30 m alignment leg.

title: Breakfast Tray Alcove Delivery
description: Take a covered breakfast tray on a two-module body down a hotel corridor to a service alcove outside a suite. Cover the clear 6 m approach in about 40 seconds, then enter the 1.2 m dead end at the same speed. After staff remove the tray, reverse the full 1.2 m in 15 seconds because there is no room to turn beside the linen cart.
payload_desc: Covered breakfast tray with restrained crockery
motion_rationale: The clear approach requires a 0.15 m/s forward peak, with reverse travel deliberately reduced to 0.08 m/s within the same surge limit for the 15-second alcove withdrawal.

title: Misrouted Cabin Bag Transfer
description: Move one strapped cabin bag from the airport exception belt to the manual inspection table. Drive forward along an 8 m fenced lane, covering clear 2.6 m sections in 10 seconds, then turn clockwise 90 degrees in five seconds inside the marked turning box. Cross the open apron diagonally front-left for 1.2 m in six seconds, slide left 0.36 m in six seconds to the table, and reverse 0.5 m after unloading.
payload_desc: Compact cabin bag secured upright
motion_rationale: The clear lane needs 0.26 m/s surge, the apron crossing needs 0.20 m/s diagonal travel, the table approach needs 0.06 m/s left sway, and the five-second quarter-turn needs 18 deg/s yaw.

title: Connector Kit Fixture Alignment
description: Carry a 16 kg connector kit on a 2x2 body from the supermarket rack to a line-side fixture 4 m ahead. Cover clear 1.4 m sections in 10 seconds, then slide left 0.12 m over eight seconds to align the tote with the fixture guides. Correct a clockwise heading error of up to four degrees over four seconds before the operator lifts the kit.

constraints: fixture guide clearance 15 mm per side

payload_desc: Fitted tray of electrical connectors and fasteners
motion_rationale: The approach needs 0.14 m/s surge, while guide alignment limits left sway to 0.015 m/s and the four-degree heading correction to 1 deg/s.

title: Reserved Books Express Return
description: Carry three reserved books from the return desk to the sorting assistant at the far end of a closed library service aisle. The single module has an unobstructed 18 m straight run and must cover each clear 5.2 m section in 20 seconds. Keep the same heading throughout and stop at the taped handoff square.
payload_desc: Three reserved books in a retaining tray
motion_rationale: Only forward surge is needed, reaching 0.26 m/s to cover clear 5.2 m aisle sections in 20 seconds before slowing for handoff.

title: Culture Rack Bench Transfer
description: Move a sealed transport carrier containing glass culture tubes between two laboratory benches using a 2x2 body. Advance 5 m along the bench aisle, covering clear 1.1 m sections in 10 seconds with gentle starts and stops. Slide right 0.45 m over 15 seconds into the receiving recess while keeping the carrier facing the same direction.

constraints: glass tubes in cushioned upright rack

payload_desc: Sealed cushioned carrier holding glass culture tubes
motion_rationale: Gentle forward transport reaches 0.11 m/s on clear bench sections, and the 0.45 m receiving insertion requires 0.03 m/s right sway for 15 seconds.

title: Cosmetics Tote Shelf Handoff
description: Bring a compact cosmetics tote from the backroom packing table to a low shelf handoff bay 3 m away. Run forward at a pace of 0.8 m per five seconds, then slide right or left to center the tote between the bay markers. Allow six seconds for a 60 mm lateral correction and ten seconds to reverse 0.4 m after staff take the tote.

constraints: 0.20 m body width in approach aisle
lateral correction only in wider bay

payload_desc: Lidded tote of boxed cosmetics
motion_rationale: The approach sets a 0.16 m/s surge peak with slower withdrawal, while either lateral correction is limited to 0.01 m/s to resolve 60 mm over six seconds.

title: Glazed Tile Sample Delivery
description: Carry a cushioned case of glazed tile samples across a swept indoor construction slab to the finish-selection table. Travel forward for 6 m, covering uninterrupted 0.9 m sections in 10 seconds, then move diagonally front-right through a clear 1 m opening in 20 seconds. Keep the case orientation fixed so its padded dividers remain aligned with the travel plan.
payload_desc: Padded case of fragile glazed tile samples
motion_rationale: Fragile sample transport limits forward surge to 0.09 m/s on the clear slab and diagonal motion to 0.05 m/s for the 20-second opening passage.

title: Low Camera Tracking Take
description: Carry a secured compact cinema camera on a low isolation mount across the studio stage. During the take, slide left along a 2.4 m track in 30 seconds without yaw, then reverse the slide to reset at the same pace. Between takes, move diagonally rear-right 0.6 m in 15 seconds to clear the actor's walking line.

constraints: wireless camera with no trailing cable
camera and mount within load limit

payload_desc: Compact cinema camera and low vibration-isolation mount
motion_rationale: The timed tracking take and reset require 0.08 m/s sway in both directions, while clearing the walking line requires a 0.04 m/s rear-right diagonal move.

title: Gallery Label Stock Delivery
description: Take a secured box of replacement labels and mounting supplies to the museum installation crew after closing. Advance 7 m along the gallery wall, covering clear 1.7 m sections in 10 seconds, then slide left through a 0.46 m opening between plinths with the 2x2 body held square. The 0.6 m sideways passage takes 20 seconds, and the body slides right along the same path after unloading.

constraints: 30 mm clearance on each body side

payload_desc: Box of gallery labels, adhesive mounts, and hand tools
motion_rationale: The wall approach needs 0.17 m/s forward surge, while the narrow plinth opening limits both sideways passages to 0.03 m/s over 0.6 m.

title: Offset Pick Tote Docking
description: Carry a small picked-parts tote down a 9 m rack aisle to a dock offset left inside the widened end bay. Cover clear 2.2 m aisle sections in 10 seconds, then move diagonally front-left along the marked 0.84 m docking line in 12 seconds without rotating. After the tote is removed, withdraw diagonally rear-right along that line.

constraints: diagonal motion only in widened end bay

payload_desc: Narrow tote of picked machine components
motion_rationale: Clear aisle sections require 0.22 m/s surge, and the offset dock approach and matching withdrawal require 0.07 m/s diagonal travel over 0.84 m in 12 seconds.

title: Instrument Mini Pallet Shuttle
description: Shuttle a 0.55 by 0.35 m mini pallet carrying boxed optical instruments between two cross-dock inspection benches. The pallet and instruments weigh 23 kg together and fit on the 2x3 body. Drive forward across the 16 m cleared lane, covering clear 1.6 m sections in 10 seconds, then slide right 0.48 m in eight seconds to the receiving bench without turning the fragile load.
payload_desc: Small pallet and foam-packed optical instruments
motion_rationale: The instrument load calls for gentle surge capped at 0.16 m/s, with 0.06 m/s right sway completing the 0.48 m bench approach in eight seconds.

title: Tote Through Guarded Station
description: Transfer a 14 kg tote from the low rack pickup point to a packing station using a 2x2 body. Advance 6 m down the rack aisle, covering clear 1.9 m sections in 10 seconds, then slide right through the station's 0.45 m guard opening. Take 12 seconds for the 0.48 m sideways passage, unload, and slide left back out without yaw.

constraints: tote fits within 0.40 m square deck

payload_desc: Compact tote of packaged hardware
motion_rationale: The rack aisle needs 0.19 m/s surge, while the guard opening restricts entry and exit sway to 0.04 m/s for each 0.48 m passage.

title: Overnight Rack Tag Sweep
description: Carry a low-mounted RFID reader along two 24 m rack faces before the morning shift. Cruise forward at a pace covering clear 5.4 m sections in 20 seconds while collecting tag reads. At the open aisle end, turn counter-clockwise 180 degrees in six seconds, slide left 1.2 m in six seconds to the next rack face, and repeat the forward scan.
payload_desc: Low-mounted RFID reader, antenna, and battery
motion_rationale: The rack sweep needs 0.27 m/s surge, the six-second 1.2 m lane change needs 0.20 m/s left sway, and the six-second half-turn needs 30 deg/s yaw.

title: Level Trailer Carton Retrieval
description: Retrieve one 12 kg carton from a low handoff stand just inside a trailer using three modules in a straight row. The trailer is immobilized and its floor is flush with the bay across a secured level steel bridge with no raised lip. Reverse empty along the 4 m approach at a pace of 0.9 m per five seconds, slide left 90 mm in six seconds beneath the handoff marks, then return forward with the carton after staff place it on the deck.

constraints: level bridge without lip or slope

payload_desc: Long narrow carton of packaged parts
motion_rationale: The level four-metre approach and return use surge up to 0.18 m/s, while matching the handoff marks needs 0.015 m/s left sway over 90 mm in six seconds.

title: Chilled Reagent Dock Approach
description: Carry an insulated reagent box along an 8 m cold-room aisle kept dry and free of ice. Cover clear 1.6 m straight sections in 10 seconds, then approach the staging dock diagonally front-right along a 0.72 m marked line in 12 seconds. Withdraw diagonally rear-left after unloading, keeping the box orientation unchanged throughout.
payload_desc: Insulated box of chilled reagent packs
motion_rationale: The dry aisle permits 0.16 m/s forward surge, while the 12-second dock approach and withdrawal need 0.06 m/s diagonal travel.

title: Mezzanine Conveyor Feed Circuit
description: Move a narrow carton tray around four low conveyor handoff points on an existing mezzanine, with the robot remaining on that level throughout. Each clear 2.1 m link takes 10 seconds at cruise, and each marked corner requires a 90-degree clockwise turn in place over three seconds. Stop for staff to transfer cartons at each handoff point and complete the four-corner circuit.
payload_desc: Retaining tray with small cartons, up to 8.2 kg combined
motion_rationale: The conveyor links need 0.21 m/s forward surge, and four three-second quarter-turns require 30 deg/s clockwise yaw within the turning bays.

title: Returns Tray Inspection Dock
description: Bring a 25 kg compartment tray of returned tools to the inspection bench on a 2x3 body. Advance along the 5 m approach, covering clear 1.3 m sections in 10 seconds, then slide left or right by up to 80 mm over eight seconds to match the bench guides. Use a counter-clockwise correction of up to three degrees over six seconds before staff transfer the tray.

constraints: heading correction in open bench bay

payload_desc: Compartment tray of returned hand tools
motion_rationale: The loaded approach peaks at 0.13 m/s surge, while precise guide matching needs 0.01 m/s sway in either direction and 0.5 deg/s counter-clockwise yaw.

title: Glass Spares Mobile Rack Retrieval
description: Collect a cushioned case of replacement glass sight tubes from a low pickup shelf inside the mobile racking. The rack aisle is locked open for the whole job; advance 7 m into its 0.38 m passage with the two modules arranged lengthwise. Cover clear 1.2 m sections in 10 seconds and reverse along the same route after loading, using gentle starts and stops because the narrow aisle has no turning space.

constraints: glass case held in padded cradle

payload_desc: Padded case of fragile glass sight tubes
motion_rationale: Forward entry and loaded reverse exit both use surge capped at 0.12 m/s, matching 1.2 m per 10 seconds while protecting the glass in the confined aisle.

title: Pharmacy Cell Side Entry
description: Deliver a sealed 21 kg cassette of boxed medicines from the replenishment desk to a pharmacy fulfilment cell using a 2x3 body. Travel forward down the 10 m service lane, covering clear 1.8 m sections in 10 seconds, then slide left through a 0.44 m opening between fixed machine guards. Keep the 0.60 m body axis along the sideways path and take 20 seconds for the final 0.50 m insertion.
payload_desc: Sealed replenishment cassette of boxed medicines
motion_rationale: Service-lane travel needs 0.18 m/s surge, while the 20 mm side clearances limit left sway to 0.025 m/s for the final 0.50 m insertion.

title: Camera Alignment At Corridor Breach
description: Carry a low search camera and light along a cleared, level strip of a partially collapsed corridor to inspect through a gap between fallen partitions. Advance 4 m, covering clear 0.7 m sections in 10 seconds, then slide right 0.10 m over 10 seconds to center the lens on the gap. Turn counter-clockwise six degrees over six seconds for the view, then reverse out along the cleared strip without crossing rubble.

constraints: intact level floor on cleared strip

payload_desc: Low search camera, LED light, and battery
motion_rationale: The cleared corridor limits entry and reverse exit to 0.07 m/s surge, while lens placement needs 0.01 m/s right sway and the viewing correction needs 1 deg/s yaw.

title: Smoke Corridor Thermal Sweep
description: Send a two-module body carrying a thermal camera and gas sensor along a previously checked, unobstructed office corridor while responders remain at the entrance. Cover clear 5 m sections of the 20 m corridor in 20 seconds, then turn clockwise 180 degrees in five seconds inside the open copier area. Return forward along the same corridor, slowing at the responder handoff point.
payload_desc: Thermal camera, gas sensor, and compact battery
motion_rationale: The checked corridor needs 0.25 m/s forward surge for each 5 m section in 20 seconds, and the five-second turnaround needs 36 deg/s clockwise yaw.

title: Garage Debris Lane Reconnaissance
description: Carry a lightweight camera beacon across one parking-garage level along a swept route between debris piles. Advance 15 m, covering clear 5.2 m sections in 20 seconds, then cross a 2.3 m marked opening diagonally front-left in 10 seconds to view behind a parked van. Retreat diagonally rear-right through the opening and reverse along the straight lane; the body never crosses loose debris or a ramp.
payload_desc: Low camera beacon with radio and light
motion_rationale: The swept lane permits 0.26 m/s forward and reverse surge, while the checked 2.3 m opening requires 0.23 m/s diagonal travel for each 10-second crossing.

title: Basement Water Gauge Placement
description: Use two splash-rated modules to carry a wireless water-level gauge to a marked wall position across a flat basement floor covered by no more than 5 mm of clean standing water. Advance 3 m along a checked strip, covering clear 0.45 m sections in 10 seconds, then slide left 60 mm over six seconds to align the gauge with the wall mark. Responders place the gauge from the stopped deck, and the body reverses along the same route.

constraints: standing water at most 5 mm deep
floor checked for holes and debris

payload_desc: Wireless water-level gauge and weighted mounting base
motion_rationale: Wet-floor entry and reverse exit are limited to 0.045 m/s surge, and the 60 mm gauge alignment needs 0.01 m/s left sway over six seconds.

title: Utility Tunnel Camera Traverse
description: Carry a low camera, work light, and gas monitor down a straight utility-tunnel walkway after a quake. The first 60 m has an intact level floor and must be surveyed forward at a pace covering clear 4.8 m sections in 20 seconds, with brief observation stops every 15 m. Reverse the full route after the end inspection because the narrow walkway has no turning bay, stopping before any damaged floor section.

constraints: halt before cracks or displaced joints

payload_desc: Low camera, work light, gas monitor, and battery
motion_rationale: The long straight survey and reverse return require surge up to 0.24 m/s, matching clear 4.8 m sections in 20 seconds while leaving time for observation stops.

title: Alternating Rack Face Picks
description: Carry a 12 kg picking tray on three modules docked in a line through a 0.74 m aisle. Cruise along each 2.4 m rack section in 15 seconds, then turn in place through 180 degrees to present the tray to the opposite rack, allowing six seconds per turn plus settling. Repeat at three marked picking positions before reversing into the collection pocket.
payload_desc: Secured picking tray of boxed hardware
motion_rationale: Forward and reverse travel use the 2.4 m per 15 second aisle pace of 0.16 m/s, while alternating six-second half-turns require 30 deg/s with additional settling time.

title: Mini Pallet Cross Dock Shuttle
description: Move a 32 kg mini pallet of fittings between cross-dock sorting islands on an eight-module body arranged 0.8 m by 0.4 m. The route has three 4.8 m straight sections cruised in 20 seconds each, with a turn in place at each junction to keep the pallet label facing the receiving lane. Alternate clockwise and counter-clockwise quarter-turns, allowing three seconds of rotation plus settling at each island.
payload_desc: Deck-sized mini pallet of boxed fittings
motion_rationale: The 4.8 m sections call for 0.24 m/s forward cruise, and three-second quarter-turns require 30 deg/s, leaving time for starts, stops, and pallet handoffs.

title: Tote Placement At Packing Nest
description: Carry a 17 kg tote from a shelf pickup point to a packing nest on a square four-module body. Cruise forward along the 3.6 m approach in 24 seconds, then slide right through a 0.12 m final offset over eight seconds while keeping the tote parallel to the nest. Reverse straight out after the operator removes the tote; the nest requires placement within 5 mm.
payload_desc: Tote of packaged machine parts
motion_rationale: The approach and reverse exit use 0.15 m/s, while the eight-second 0.12 m rightward correction limits sway to 0.015 m/s for accurate placement.

title: Rack Scan And Offset Dock
description: Carry a 4 kg barcode camera assembly along an 8.4 m rack face on a square four-module body, cruising at a pace that covers the scan length in 60 seconds. At the rack end, approach the charging target diagonally front-left along a marked 0.75 m segment over ten seconds without changing camera heading. The scan lane opens into a clear docking apron.
payload_desc: Low-mounted barcode camera and illumination unit
motion_rationale: Rack imaging sets forward cruise at 8.4/60 = 0.14 m/s, and the ten-second 0.75 m front-left docking approach calls for 0.075 m/s diagonal travel.

title: Trailer Tool Case Unload
description: Carry a secured 28 kg tool case from inside a parked trailer to an indoor receiving stand on a six-module rectangular body. The trailer floor and dock are flush across a secured level bridge plate; cruise forward along the 9.6 m route in 80 seconds. At the receiving stand, slide left by 0.48 m over eight seconds and reverse along the same route after unloading.
payload_desc: Compact steel tool case secured across six decks
motion_rationale: The heavy case travels forward and backward at the 9.6 m per 80 second pace of 0.12 m/s, with a slower 0.06 m/s left slide for the eight-second stand approach.

title: Cold Room Sample Circuit
description: Deliver a 9 kg insulated sample box to four cold-room checking points on a square four-module body. Cruise along 2.1 m aisle sections in 15 seconds and turn in place at the widened rack ends to face each checking point. Each clockwise or counter-clockwise quarter-turn has three seconds of rotation followed by a stationary temperature reading.
payload_desc: Insulated box of sealed food samples
motion_rationale: The short cold-room legs require 0.14 m/s forward cruise, and repeated three-second quarter-turns require 30 deg/s before stationary readings.

title: Mezzanine Conveyor Side Feed
description: Move a 14 kg carton tray along a level mezzanine already occupied by the robot; no stair or lift travel is part of this job. A square four-module body cruises forward through a 0.46 m guide passage for 2.8 m in 20 seconds, then slides right along a 0.42 m crosswise guide over 14 seconds to the conveyor feed position. Slide left back to the passage and reverse out after the tray is lifted.
payload_desc: Restrained tray of small cartons
motion_rationale: Forward and reverse passage travel use 0.14 m/s, while the tight crosswise guide limits both lateral directions to 0.42/14 = 0.03 m/s.

title: Dense Returns Bin Transfer
description: Carry a 9.4 kg bin of returned metal fittings on a two-module body from the weighing bench to the inspection table. Cruise forward along the 4.4 m lane in 40 seconds, then slide left by 0.36 m over six seconds into the table-side unloading pocket. Keep the bin facing the operator and reverse out after unloading.
payload_desc: Lidded bin of returned metal fittings
motion_rationale: The near-capacity bin sets forward and reverse cruise at 0.11 m/s, with 0.06 m/s leftward sway covering the 0.36 m unloading offset in six seconds.

title: Mobile Rack Endcap Delivery
description: Take a 16 kg replenishment tote down a locked-open mobile-rack aisle on a square four-module body. The straight cruise section is 24.3 m and must be covered in 90 seconds before slowing at the endcap handoff mark. Reverse the full aisle after unloading because the endcap has no turning space.
payload_desc: Replenishment tote of packaged stock
motion_rationale: The 24.3 m cruise section and 90-second travel target require 0.27 m/s in both forward and reverse, with separate time for terminal slowing and unloading.

title: Pharmacy Verification Tray Loop
description: Carry a 3 kg tray of sealed prescriptions from a dispenser to a verification station on a two-module body. Cruise forward 2.4 m in 12 seconds, turn clockwise in place through 90 degrees over three seconds, and go diagonally front-right along a 0.6 m marked approach over five seconds. Slide left 0.1 m over five seconds for scanner alignment, then reverse away after verification.
payload_desc: Divided tray of sealed prescription packs
motion_rationale: The route needs 0.2 m/s straight travel, 30 deg/s clockwise rotation, 0.12 m/s front-right diagonal approach, and a 0.02 m/s left slide for the five-second scanner correction.

title: Corridor Search Relay Placement
description: Carry a 1.6 kg camera and radio relay on one module through a cleared strip of flat floor beside a collapsed corridor partition. Cruise forward along the 4.2 m strip in 30 seconds, then move diagonally front-left along a 0.56 m marked path over eight seconds to dock against a responder's relay cradle. Keep the camera pointed down the corridor throughout the approach.

constraints: no loose rubble in wheel path

payload_desc: Camera and compact radio relay
motion_rationale: The cleared corridor permits 0.14 m/s forward cruise, followed by a 0.07 m/s front-left diagonal approach covering 0.56 m in eight seconds.

title: Office Respirator Cache Delivery
description: Rush a 4 kg respirator supply pouch to a responder staging point across a smoke-filled office floor on a six-module rectangular body. A surveyed 16.2 m corridor cruise section has a 60-second target, and the final 2.4 m open-floor approach runs diagonally front-right over ten seconds. Hold heading through both legs and stop at the staging mat for manual unloading.
payload_desc: Respirator filters and sealed escape hoods
motion_rationale: The urgent 16.2 m corridor cruise requires 0.27 m/s forward travel, and the 2.4 m front-right staging approach requires 0.24 m/s over ten seconds.

title: Garage Search Camera Traverse
description: Carry a 3.2 kg search camera and work light along a cleared parking-garage lane using three modules docked in a line. The flat 21.6 m cruise section between debris piles is traversed in 90 seconds, with stationary camera checks at both ends. Reverse along the same lane because the far end is blocked by a fallen barrier.
payload_desc: Low-mounted search camera and work light
motion_rationale: The long cleared lane calls for 21.6/90 = 0.24 m/s forward and reverse cruise, with inspection pauses and terminal slowing outside that cruise interval.

title: Basement Water Sensor Docking
description: Carry a 6 kg water-quality sampling kit to a wall-side sampling cradle on a square four-module body through a basement with 5 mm of standing water. Cruise forward along the 3 m cleared route in 50 seconds, then approach diagonally rear-right along a 0.45 m marked segment over 15 seconds to seat the kit beside the cradle. Keep the sample ports facing the wall and stop for a manual sample transfer.
payload_desc: Secured water-quality sampling kit
motion_rationale: Wet-floor travel limits forward cruise to 3/50 = 0.06 m/s, and the fifteen-second 0.45 m rear-right docking approach requires 0.03 m/s.

title: Tunnel Wall Gap Survey
description: Carry a 4.5 kg crack-imaging unit through a cleared service-tunnel strip on three modules docked in a line, with the 0.2 m body width facing a 0.29 m gap. Cruise forward 6.3 m in 70 seconds, then slide right 0.04 m over four seconds to position the lens beside a wall crack. Slide left to recenter and reverse out without turning.
payload_desc: Compact crack camera and lighting bar
motion_rationale: The narrow tunnel sets straight travel at 6.3/70 = 0.09 m/s, while four-second 0.04 m lateral corrections require only 0.01 m/s in either direction.

title: Evacuation Radio Battery Run
description: Deliver a 2.8 kg pack of radio batteries and patient identification bands to an evacuation desk on a square four-module body. Cruise forward through an attendant-cleared 18.9 m hospital corridor section in 70 seconds, then slide left 0.6 m over five seconds into the desk recess. Slide right out of the recess and reverse to the supply point after unloading.
payload_desc: Radio batteries and patient identification bands
motion_rationale: The urgent corridor run requires 18.9/70 = 0.27 m/s straight cruise, while five-second 0.6 m slides into and out of the desk recess require 0.12 m/s.

title: Landing Communication Cradle Approach
description: Move a 1.2 kg communication repeater from the fire door to a wall cradle entirely within one flat stairwell landing using a single module. Advance 1.2 m at a ten-second cruise pace, then go diagonally front-right along a 0.48 m approach over eight seconds to the cradle. The route stays behind a temporary barrier separating the working area from the stair opening.
payload_desc: Compact communication repeater
motion_rationale: The short landing transit uses 0.12 m/s forward cruise, and the eight-second 0.48 m front-right cradle approach requires 0.06 m/s diagonal travel.

title: Fire Evidence Vial Transfer
description: Carry a 3.6 kg padded rack of sealed glass evidence vials from a cooled warehouse sampling point to the investigation bench on two modules. Cruise forward along a swept 4.8 m path in 60 seconds, turn counter-clockwise in place through 90 degrees over ten seconds in a clear square, and slide right 0.24 m over eight seconds beside the bench. Use gentle starts and stops to keep the fragile vials upright.

constraints: area cooled and released for access

payload_desc: Padded carrier of sealed glass evidence vials
motion_rationale: Fragile-vial transport uses 0.08 m/s forward cruise, a ten-second quarter-turn at 9 deg/s, and a 0.03 m/s right slide for the eight-second bench offset.

title: Carriage Emergency Supply Traverse
description: Carry an 8 kg bag of dressings and drinking water down a stationary train carriage on a square four-module body. Cruise forward along the 14.4 m straight aisle section in 60 seconds to a responder beside the far vestibule, then reverse back after unloading. The body stays inside this carriage and passes through no inter-car connection.
payload_desc: Restrained bag of dressings and bottled water
motion_rationale: The unobstructed 14.4 m carriage aisle requires 0.24 m/s forward and reverse cruise to meet each 60-second straight-run target.

title: Refuge Alcove Sensor Retrieval
description: Retrieve a 7 kg removable air-monitoring cartridge from a blind equipment alcove in a mine refuge chamber using three modules docked in a line. Enter forward along the 3.6 m narrow alcove at a 30-second cruise pace and wait while a responder secures the cartridge. Reverse out at a slower 45-second cruise pace because rear visibility is restricted, with no room to turn.
payload_desc: Removable air-monitoring cartridge loaded at alcove end
motion_rationale: Forward entry sets the straight-axis peak at 3.6/30 = 0.12 m/s, while the restricted-view reverse exit uses 3.6/45 = 0.08 m/s.

title: Cold Aisle Thermal Survey
description: Carry a 2.4 kg thermal camera and airflow probe along a data-centre cold aisle on two modules. Cruise forward along 7.2 m of cabinet fronts in 60 seconds, then approach the calibration dock diagonally rear-left along a 0.63 m marked segment over nine seconds in the aisle-end apron. Keep the camera facing the cabinets until the calibration hood encloses it.
payload_desc: Thermal camera and compact airflow probe
motion_rationale: Thermal scanning requires 0.12 m/s forward cruise, and the nine-second 0.63 m rear-left calibration approach requires 0.07 m/s diagonal travel.

title: Inverter Cabinet Side Traverse
description: Carry a 12 kg electrical inspection instrument on a six-module body arranged 0.6 m long by 0.4 m wide inside an inverter room. Cruise forward along the 4 m cabinet passage in 40 seconds, then slide left 1.05 m over 35 seconds through a crosswise passage only 0.68 m wide in the body's long dimension. Stop at three cabinet windows during that lateral traverse, then slide right and reverse to the doorway.

constraints: 40 mm clearance at each body end

payload_desc: Secured acoustic and thermal inspection instrument
motion_rationale: Cabinet entry and reverse exit use 4/40 = 0.1 m/s, while the tightly confined crosswise passage requires 1.05/35 = 0.03 m/s lateral cruise with separate inspection pauses.

title: Underwing Camera Position Sprint
description: Carry a 1.8 kg upward-facing camera under a parked aircraft wing on a two-module body. Cruise forward across a clear 10.8 m hangar lane in 40 seconds, then travel diagonally front-left along a 2.6 m marked segment in ten seconds to the inspection position. After imaging, move diagonally rear-right along the same segment and reverse to the equipment cart.

constraints: marked route clear of landing gear

payload_desc: Low-profile upward-facing camera and light
motion_rationale: The light camera needs 0.27 m/s straight cruise for the 10.8 m lane and 0.26 m/s diagonal travel for each ten-second 2.6 m underwing segment.

title: Engine Room Gauge Alignment
description: Carry a 5 kg optical gauge reader along a flat engine-room deck on three modules docked in a line while the ship is moored. Cruise forward along 2.7 m of clear deck in 30 seconds, then turn clockwise in place through 12 degrees over six seconds in a widened inspection bay. Slide left 0.045 m over nine seconds to center the reader on a gauge window within 3 mm, then reverse away after the reading.

constraints: ship moored with negligible deck motion

payload_desc: Optical gauge reader on a low rigid mount
motion_rationale: Deck transit uses 0.09 m/s forward and reverse cruise, while precise reader alignment needs a 2 deg/s clockwise correction and a nine-second left slide at 0.005 m/s.

title: Turbine Hall Survey Circuit
description: Carry a 4 kg vibration and thermal survey package between marked inspection positions in a turbine hall on two modules. Cruise forward along a 6.6 m lane in 30 seconds, turn counter-clockwise in place through 90 degrees over two seconds in a clear bay, then travel diagonally front-right 1.1 m over ten seconds toward a bearing pedestal. Slide right 0.18 m over six seconds to align with a viewing window, take a stationary reading, and reverse 1.2 m at a ten-second pace to clear the pedestal.
payload_desc: Compact vibration and thermal survey package
motion_rationale: The circuit needs 0.22 m/s forward cruise with a slower 0.12 m/s reverse withdrawal, 45 deg/s counter-clockwise rotation, 0.11 m/s front-right diagonal approach, and 0.03 m/s rightward window alignment.

title: Cold Aisle Sensor Delivery
description: Carry a padded tray of calibrated airflow probes along a 9 m cold aisle to the rack technician, allowing 75 seconds for steady forward travel. Keep the tray facing the racks and slide left 0.24 m over 12 seconds into the receiving position; no turning is required.
payload_desc: Fragile airflow probes secured in a padded 0.38 m tray
motion_rationale: Forward travel peaks at 0.12 m/s for the 9 m steady leg in 75 seconds, while the fragile tray requires a left slide capped at 0.02 m/s for the 0.24 m receiving approach.

title: Inverter Cabinet Recess Survey
description: Carry a thermal camera on three modules docked in a straight 0.6 m line into a cabinet recess with no turning space. Drive forward along the 4.2 m inspection line in 35 seconds, stop for images, then reverse out along the same line in 28 seconds with the rear clearance sensor active.
payload_desc: Secured thermal camera and low mounting bracket
motion_rationale: The slower forward survey uses 0.12 m/s, while the clear 4.2 m reverse exit in 28 seconds sets the surge peak at 0.15 m/s.

title: Underwing Leak Camera Withdrawal
description: Move a low camera and collection-pad tray under a parked aircraft wing to inspect a suspected hydraulic drip beside a landing-gear fixture. Three modules in a straight line advance 3.6 m in 40 seconds and reverse the same distance after inspection, then slide right 0.45 m over 9 seconds once clear of the fixture.
payload_desc: Low inspection camera and secured absorbent-pad tray
motion_rationale: Restricted underwing clearance limits both 3.6 m longitudinal legs to 0.09 m/s, and the unobstructed 0.45 m right slide takes 9 seconds at 0.05 m/s.

title: Engine Room Acoustic Survey
description: Carry a compact acoustic recorder along an 11.7 m clear engine-room deck lane during a dockside maintenance shutdown, covering the steady transit in 45 seconds. At the open machinery bay, turn clockwise in place through 90 degrees over 3 seconds to aim the recorder at the next measurement point.
payload_desc: Compact acoustic recorder on a vibration-isolated bracket
motion_rationale: The clear 11.7 m transit requires 0.26 m/s over 45 seconds, and the clockwise 90-degree aiming turn uses 30 deg/s over 3 seconds.

title: Turbine Hall Vibration Route
description: Carry a secured vibration logger from the instrument bench to a turbine bearing inspection station along a straight 42 m marked lane. Travel forward at a steady pace for 168 seconds between acceleration zones, keeping the logger facing the station throughout.
payload_desc: Vibration logger and probe case strapped across two decks
motion_rationale: The uninterrupted 42 m lane calls for a 0.25 m/s forward cruise lasting 168 seconds, with extra job time for acceleration and handoff.

title: Pipe Gallery Valve Inspection
description: Carry a camera head on a 2-by-2 body through a level enclosed pipe gallery, driving forward along a 6 m lane in 40 seconds before turning counter-clockwise 90 degrees in 5 seconds inside a widened bay. Slide left 0.36 m in 6 seconds to clear a support, approach the valve diagonally front-right along a 0.84 m path in 12 seconds, and reverse 0.6 m after imaging.
payload_desc: Low camera head with lighting and battery pack
motion_rationale: The 6 m transit sets surge at 0.15 m/s, the support clearance uses 0.06 m/s left sway, the valve approach uses 0.07 m/s diagonally, and the bay turn needs 18 deg/s.

title: Enclosed Bridge Walkway Survey
description: Carry an inspection camera and lighting pack along the enclosed, level maintenance walkway inside a box-girder bridge beneath the road deck. The 2-by-3 body drives forward 12 m to a closed bulkhead and reverses the full distance because the 0.72 m walkway has no turning bay, allowing 100 seconds of travel each way.
payload_desc: Inspection camera, lighting pack, and secured battery case
motion_rationale: Both 12 m legs use a 0.12 m/s surge limit to fit 100-second travel windows while maintaining clearance along the narrow enclosed walkway.

title: Nacelle Borescope Kit Positioning
description: Carry a 13.8 kg borescope and fixture kit from its storage cradle to the gearbox inspection port inside a stopped wind-turbine nacelle. Three modules docked lengthwise travel forward 2.8 m over 40 seconds on a continuous level floor strip, then slide left 0.18 m over 12 seconds to place the case beside the technician.
payload_desc: Secured borescope case and compact gearbox inspection fixture
motion_rationale: The near-capacity load travels the 2.8 m strip at 0.07 m/s, followed by a precise 0.18 m left placement at 0.015 m/s.

title: Cleanroom Optical Reference Transfer
description: Carry a shock-isolated optical reference assembly across a cleanroom metrology bay on a 2-by-2 body. Follow a 2.16 m front-left diagonal path over 36 seconds, then slide right 0.12 m over 10 seconds to align the tray with the receiving fixture without rotating it.
payload_desc: Fragile optical reference assembly in a covered isolation tray
motion_rationale: The isolated assembly follows the 2.16 m diagonal at 0.06 m/s and finishes with a 0.012 m/s right slide for the 0.12 m fixture alignment.

title: Parking Column Scanner Docking
description: Carry a compact column scanner along a 5.4 m lane on an enclosed parking level, taking 30 seconds of steady forward travel. Approach the charging target beside the column diagonally front-right along a 0.72 m path over 12 seconds, then reverse 0.15 m slowly if the scanner needs a second reading.
payload_desc: Compact optical column scanner with low mounting frame
motion_rationale: The 5.4 m lane sets forward surge at 0.18 m/s, the short reverse adjustment stays below that peak, and the 0.72 m diagonal dock approach uses 0.06 m/s.

title: Hospital Dressing Cart Handoff
description: Carry a sealed dressing-supply cassette from the clean store along an 18 m hospital service corridor, allowing 90 seconds of steady forward travel. At the ward hatch, keep the cassette facing forward and move diagonally front-left along a 0.9 m path over 15 seconds into a recessed receiving position.
payload_desc: Sealed cassette of sterile dressings on a two-module tray
motion_rationale: The service corridor permits 0.2 m/s forward travel over 18 m in 90 seconds, while the recessed hatch requires a 0.06 m/s front-left diagonal approach.

title: Hotel Breakfast Tray Delivery
description: Carry a restrained breakfast tray with porcelain cups and covered juice glasses along a 12 m hotel corridor, using 100 seconds of steady forward travel. At the room-service alcove, turn clockwise in place through 90 degrees over 10 seconds, then slide right 0.3 m over 10 seconds to present the tray.
payload_desc: Breakfast tray with restrained porcelain and covered drinks
motion_rationale: The fragile service uses 0.12 m/s on the corridor, 9 deg/s for the ten-second clockwise turn, and 0.03 m/s for the rightward presentation slide.

title: Baggage Inspection Tray Return
description: Return a shallow tray of small cleared baggage items from an inspection desk to a conveyor handoff in the airport baggage hall. Drive forward 15.6 m in 60 seconds along the protected lane, then move diagonally front-right along a 1.35 m path in 15 seconds to enter the angled receiving pocket.
payload_desc: Cleared small baggage items secured in a 0.4 m square tray
motion_rationale: The protected 15.6 m lane needs 0.26 m/s forward travel, and the angled 1.35 m pocket approach needs a reduced diagonal speed of 0.09 m/s.

title: Assembly Cell Kit Exchange
description: Take a fastener kit into a blind line-side pocket between two fixed benches using a lengthwise two-module body. Advance 2.4 m in 20 seconds, wait for the operator to exchange the cassette, and reverse 2.4 m in 16 seconds because the pocket is too narrow to turn.
payload_desc: Exchange cassette containing sorted fasteners and small brackets
motion_rationale: The loaded entry uses 0.12 m/s and the clear 2.4 m reverse withdrawal in 16 seconds sets the surge peak at 0.15 m/s.

title: Library Return Bin Docking
description: Carry a compact bin of returned books through a 7.2 m staff sorting aisle in 60 seconds. The station stands behind the starting side of a desk end, so keep the book spines facing the sorter and move diagonally rear-left along a 0.6 m path over 12 seconds into its docking marks.
payload_desc: Compact return bin of books secured across two decks
motion_rationale: The sorting aisle requires 0.12 m/s forward travel, followed by a 0.05 m/s rear-left diagonal to cover the 0.6 m docking path in 12 seconds.

title: Laboratory Batch Rack Express
description: Carry a lightweight, wide rack of capped sample tubes on a 2-by-3 body between two laboratory pass-through stations. Use the reserved 20.1 m corridor for a 75-second steady forward transit, then slide right 0.48 m in 8 seconds to align the rack with the receiving shelf.

constraints: wide rack supported across six decks

payload_desc: Wide 0.58 by 0.38 m batch rack of capped sample tubes
motion_rationale: The reserved 20.1 m corridor requires near-full forward speed of 0.268 m/s over 75 seconds, while the shelf alignment uses a 0.06 m/s right slide.

title: Backroom Blind Aisle Restock
description: Carry a secured carton of toiletries down a 5.6 m blind backroom aisle to the shelf replenishment point on a 2-by-2 body. Drive forward in 40 seconds and reverse out in 35 seconds after unloading, then slide left 0.8 m over 10 seconds in the clear cross aisle to reach the empty-carton station.
payload_desc: Secured carton of boxed toiletries within a 0.4 m square footprint
motion_rationale: The loaded entry uses 0.14 m/s, the 5.6 m reverse exit sets surge at 0.16 m/s, and the clear 0.8 m cross-aisle slide uses 0.08 m/s.

title: Indoor Fitout Parts Circuit
description: Deliver a secured tray of door hardware to four marked workstations on a swept indoor slab. Travel forward along three 4.8 m legs in 30 seconds each, turning in place through 90 degrees at each clear junction in 2.5 seconds, with both clockwise and counter-clockwise turns needed to follow the partition layout.
payload_desc: Partitioned tray of door handles, hinges, and fixings
motion_rationale: Each 4.8 m leg needs 0.16 m/s forward travel, and repeated 90-degree junction turns in 2.5 seconds require 36 deg/s in both yaw directions.

title: Miniature Set Camera Moves
description: Carry a compact remote camera on a low bracket through a miniature film set, creeping forward and reversing along a 1.2 m track in 24 seconds each way. Between takes, turn in place clockwise and counter-clockwise through 60 degrees over 5 seconds to frame alternating doorways without moving the camera base to another mark.
payload_desc: Compact remote camera and low rigid mounting bracket
motion_rationale: The 1.2 m filming moves require 0.05 m/s forward and reverse travel, while the five-second 60-degree reframing turns require 12 deg/s in either direction.

title: Museum Plinth Base Relocation
description: Move a compact 27 kg steel plinth base between display positions after the gallery closes, using six modules in a 2-by-3 block with the load centered and restrained. Travel forward 6.3 m over 90 seconds, then slide left 0.32 m over 16 seconds to place the base beside the curator's floor marks.
payload_desc: Compact steel plinth base on a 0.58 by 0.38 m support tray
motion_rationale: The heavy base needs a controlled 0.07 m/s forward transit over 6.3 m and a 0.02 m/s left slide for the final 0.32 m placement.

title: Express Small Parts Picking
description: Carry a lightweight pick bin on a lengthwise two-module body down a reserved 13 m narrow aisle, covering the clear transit in 50 seconds. At the pick face, slide right 0.1 m over 5 seconds for loading, slide left to regain the centerline, and reverse down the aisle at the same transit pace.
payload_desc: Narrow pick bin containing packaged electronic connectors
motion_rationale: The reserved 13 m aisle supports 0.26 m/s forward and reverse transit, while the 0.1 m rack approaches take 5 seconds at 0.02 m/s in each sway direction.

title: Fragile Mini Pallet Shuttle
description: Shuttle a 0.58 by 0.38 m miniature pallet of boxed glass instrument parts between two cross-dock benches on a six-module body. Drive forward 8.4 m over 70 seconds, then move diagonally front-right along a 0.64 m path over 16 seconds to reach the receiving marks without rotating the pallet.
payload_desc: Miniature pallet and foam-packed glass instrument parts
motion_rationale: The fragile pallet travels the 8.4 m lane at 0.12 m/s and approaches the receiving marks diagonally at 0.04 m/s over the final 0.64 m.

title: Tote Transfer Nest Alignment
description: Carry a loaded tote from a shelf handoff to a packing station on a 2-by-3 body, driving forward 10.2 m in 60 seconds. At the transfer nest, slide left 0.096 m over 8 seconds, creep forward the final 0.12 m, and reverse 0.12 m after the station lifts off the tote; the nest has only 8 mm of side clearance.
payload_desc: Loaded 0.58 by 0.38 m tote with rigid locating features
motion_rationale: The 10.2 m transit sets surge at 0.17 m/s with final insertion and withdrawal limited to 0.01 m/s, while the tight nest needs a 0.012 m/s left alignment slide.

title: Alternating Rack Inventory Scan
description: Carry a small barcode imager through a rack inspection aisle, advancing in 2.4 m intervals over 12 seconds each. At four marked scan pads, turn in place 180 degrees in 4 seconds, alternating clockwise and counter-clockwise to face opposite rack rows before continuing forward along the newly faced direction.
payload_desc: Small barcode imager on a low centered mount
motion_rationale: Each 2.4 m advance takes 12 seconds at 0.2 m/s, and repeated 180-degree scan turns in 4 seconds need 45 deg/s in both yaw directions.

title: Level Trailer Carton Withdrawal
description: Receive a dense 9.6 kg carton on a two-module body inside a restrained trailer at an enclosed loading bay. Reverse 7.2 m out of the trailer over 60 seconds across a secured flush bridge plate with no slope, then slide right 0.42 m over 7 seconds to the unload bench while keeping the carton facing the trailer.
payload_desc: Dense replacement-parts carton secured on a two-module tray
motion_rationale: The near-capacity carton requires a 0.12 m/s reverse withdrawal over 7.2 m, followed by a 0.06 m/s right slide across the 0.42 m bench approach.

title: Pipe Gallery Thermal Survey
description: Carry a thermal camera and logger on a four-module square body through the level pipe gallery. Travel forward along a 9 m service lane in about 50 seconds, slide left 0.6 m beneath a valve bank in 10 seconds, and reverse out after recording. At the widened junction, turn clockwise 90 degrees in 6 seconds and go diagonally front-right 1.2 m in 10 seconds to the final inspection mark.
payload_desc: Low-mounted thermal camera, battery and data logger
motion_rationale: Forward and reverse travel peak at 0.186 m/s for the service lane, the valve-bank slide needs 0.064 m/s, the diagonal approach needs 0.126 m/s, and the junction turn peaks at 16 deg/s to allow gentle starts and stops.

title: Underdeck Optical Reference Delivery
description: Carry a padded optical reference assembly along an enclosed, level maintenance walkway beneath the bridge deck. The two-module body travels forward 7.2 m in about 95 seconds, then slides right 0.24 m in 12 seconds to an inspector's pickup mark. Keep its heading fixed between the handrail and instrument cases to avoid disturbing the glass assembly.
payload_desc: Glass optical reference assembly in a restrained foam cradle
motion_rationale: The fragile assembly limits forward travel to 0.081 m/s for the roughly 95-second walkway leg and the final rightward slide to 0.023 m/s for a cushioned 12-second placement.

title: Nacelle Cable Pocket Inspection
description: With the turbine stopped and secured, send one module carrying a low camera into a level cable-service pocket on the nacelle floor. Drive forward 1.8 m in about 24 seconds, pause to inspect the cable glands, and reverse the same distance in about 30 seconds. The 0.28 m passage ends at a bulkhead and has no turning space.
payload_desc: Low inspection camera and LED illuminator
motion_rationale: Only forward and reverse motion are needed, with a 0.079 m/s peak supporting the 24-second entry and a slower approximately 0.063 m/s reverse exit.

title: Cleanroom Tool Gap Survey
description: Carry a compact particle counter through a 0.25 m clear gap between two tool enclosures using a cleanroom-qualified single module. Keep the sensor facing the tool and slide left 2.4 m in about 65 seconds, stopping at three sampling marks. Slide right along the same path to return; there is no room to yaw.
payload_desc: Compact particle counter with short sampling inlet
motion_rationale: Left and right slides peak at 0.043 m/s so each 2.4 m traverse allows roughly 65 seconds of movement with gentle approaches to the sampling marks.

title: Column Recess Crack Scan
description: Carry a crack-imaging camera on a fore-and-aft pair through a closed parking inspection zone. Drive forward 3.6 m into a 0.34 m gap between a column and a protective barrier in about 36 seconds, scan, and reverse out without turning. In the open staging square, turn counter-clockwise 180 degrees in about 9 seconds to face the next column.
payload_desc: Crack-imaging camera, grazing light and recorder
motion_rationale: A 0.106 m/s surge peak supports the approximately 36-second entry and reverse legs, while a 23 deg/s yaw peak completes the staged half-turn in about 9 seconds.

title: Ward Dressing Pack Delivery
description: Move a sealed dressing-pack tote from the supply room to a ward receiving shelf on a two-module body. Cover the 18 m cleared corridor in about 80 seconds, turn clockwise 90 degrees in 4 seconds at the junction, and cross the vestibule diagonally front-left for 2.1 m in 14 seconds. Slide right 0.36 m in 9 seconds beneath the receiving shelf, then reverse 0.8 m after staff remove the tote.
payload_desc: Lidded tote of sterile dressing packs
motion_rationale: The long corridor needs a 0.237 m/s surge peak, the vestibule diagonal needs 0.158 m/s, the shelf slide needs 0.044 m/s, and the four-second junction turn needs a 27 deg/s peak.

title: Room Service Tray Handoff
description: Carry a restrained breakfast tray on three modules arranged in a line along the hotel corridor. Travel forward 6 m in about 55 seconds and stop alongside the room's service table without turning. Slide left 0.3 m in about 18 seconds, making the last 30 mm at 0.006 m/s so the tray edge aligns with the table.

constraints: firm flat carpet without loose edges

payload_desc: Breakfast tray with covered dishes and lidded drinks
motion_rationale: Forward travel peaks at 0.117 m/s for the 55-second corridor leg, while the 0.023 m/s lateral peak leaves time for the final 0.006 m/s alignment crawl.

title: Baggage Tag Stock Express
description: Carry a carton of baggage-tag rolls on a three-module line body from the stock cage to the printer island. The segregated service lane is straight for 42 m and the moving portion of the run should take about 165 seconds. Keep heading fixed, drive forward throughout, and slow for the marked receiving box.
payload_desc: Carton of baggage-tag rolls and printer ribbons
motion_rationale: A 0.263 m/s forward peak is needed to cover the 42 m straight lane in about 165 seconds while allowing acceleration and receiving-box deceleration.

title: Ceramic Insulator Kit Transfer
description: Carry a padded tray of ceramic insulators on a six-module 0.6 by 0.4 m body from inspection to the assembly fixture. Move forward along the 8 m line-side lane in about 100 seconds, then slide right 0.5 m in 16 seconds into the handoff space. Keep the tray heading unchanged and avoid abrupt corrections beside the fixture.
payload_desc: Foam-pocket tray of fragile ceramic electrical insulators
motion_rationale: The padded ceramics require a restrained 0.086 m/s forward peak over the 100-second lane leg and a 0.036 m/s rightward peak for the 16-second handoff slide.

title: Returned Hardback Bin Haul
description: Move a low bin of returned hardbacks on a six-module rectangular body from the sorting desk to the shelving station. Drive forward 12 m in about 90 seconds, turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees in 8 seconds within the clear end bay, and reverse 1.2 m into the unloading position in about 20 seconds. The book bin fits entirely within the deck and is secured against sliding.
payload_desc: Low rigid bin of returned hardback books, including bin mass
motion_rationale: Loaded forward travel peaks at 0.143 m/s, the short reverse placement uses approximately 0.066 m/s, and a 13 deg/s yaw peak allows the heavy bin to complete its quarter-turn gently in 8 seconds.

title: Chilled Sample Carrier Transfer
description: Carry a compact chilled carrier containing sealed sample racks on a four-module square body between laboratory receiving and the cold-room handoff. Go diagonally front-right across the clear 4.8 m staging area in about 40 seconds, then drive forward 5.4 m through the instrument aisle in 45 seconds. Slide left 0.28 m in 14 seconds to place the carrier beside the technician's bench.
payload_desc: Chilled sample carrier with sealed racks and cooling inserts
motion_rationale: The near-capacity carrier needs gentle peaks of 0.129 m/s diagonally and 0.128 m/s forward for the two transit legs, followed by a 0.024 m/s left slide for bench placement.

title: Backroom Toiletry Carton Run
description: Move a strapped carton of toiletries on a four-module square body from the receiving bench to the sales-floor staging door. The backroom has a clear 30 m straight lane, with about 120 seconds allocated to travel. Drive forward to the marked stop and reverse the same route after staff unload the carton.

constraints: lane kept clear of stock cages

payload_desc: Strapped carton of boxed toiletries
motion_rationale: Forward and reverse legs require a 0.259 m/s peak to cover each 30 m straight run in approximately 120 seconds including acceleration and stopping.

title: Survey Target Base Placement
description: Carry a weighted survey-target base across a swept, level indoor slab on a four-module square body. Travel forward 4 m in about 40 seconds, turn clockwise 12 degrees in 6 seconds, and slide right 0.18 m in about 15 seconds to align the base with a chalk cross. Make the final 20 mm of the slide at 0.004 m/s before the surveyor lifts the base onto the mark.
payload_desc: Compact weighted survey-target base with folded target
motion_rationale: The slab traverse needs a 0.108 m/s forward peak, the six-second heading correction needs 2.6 deg/s, and the 0.019 m/s rightward peak permits a final 0.004 m/s alignment crawl.

title: Straight Studio Tracking Take
description: Carry a compact remotely operated camera on a low mount across the level studio floor using a six-module rectangular body. Start from a run-up mark, track forward for 10.8 m at 0.18 m/s during a 60-second take, then decelerate in the run-out area. Reverse to the start after the take without changing the camera heading.
payload_desc: Compact camera, remote head, low mount and battery
motion_rationale: The recorded 10.8 m tracking segment fixes the forward peak at 0.18 m/s for 60 seconds, and the reverse reset uses the same ceiling with gentle acceleration outside the take.

title: Gallery Label Proof Express
description: Carry a small envelope of replacement label proofs on one module from the curator's desk to the installation team after closing. Cross the clear gallery diagonally front-left for 7.5 m in about 30 seconds, then drive forward 3 m through the display gap in about 15 seconds. Stop at the staff pickup mark clear of the display plinths.
payload_desc: Clipped document envelope containing label proofs
motion_rationale: The urgent clear-floor diagonal needs a near-limit 0.266 m/s peak to cover 7.5 m in about 30 seconds, while the narrower final leg needs a 0.218 m/s forward peak.

title: Narrow Pick Slot Retrieval
description: Send one module with an empty small-parts tray forward 5 m through a 0.27 m clear picking lane in about 65 seconds. At the marked opening, slide left 0.16 m in 10 seconds so a picker can load the tray. Slide right back into the lane and reverse to the collection station without turning.
payload_desc: Small-parts tray with picked fastener packets at maximum load
motion_rationale: The tight lane limits forward and reverse peaks to 0.083 m/s for roughly 65-second traverses, and each 0.16 m pick-opening slide needs a 0.019 m/s peak over 10 seconds.

title: Mini Pallet Shuttle Docking
description: Carry a lightweight 0.36 by 0.18 m sample pallet on a fore-and-aft two-module body across the cross-dock to a low receiving fixture. Drive forward 6 m in about 42 seconds, then slide right 0.22 m in about 16 seconds while keeping the pallet parallel to the fixture. Complete the last 20 mm at 0.005 m/s so the pallet's locating tabs line up for manual transfer.
payload_desc: Lightweight miniature pallet with boxed sample parts, including pallet mass
motion_rationale: Cross-dock transit needs a 0.153 m/s forward peak, while a 0.019 m/s lateral peak leaves four seconds for the final 20 mm locating-tab alignment at 0.005 m/s.

title: Four Bay Tote Circuit
description: Carry a small tote on one module around four shelf-end handoff bays before reaching the packing station. Each bay requires a counter-clockwise 90-degree turn in place in about 2.5 seconds so the tote opening faces the operator, followed by a forward 2 m leg taking about 12 seconds. All four turns occur on marked clear squares outside the shelf aisles.
payload_desc: Small tote of packed electronic accessories
motion_rationale: The short forward legs need a 0.183 m/s peak, and repeated 2.5-second quarter-turns need a 44 deg/s yaw peak with time allowed for rotational acceleration and braking.

title: Rack Imager Calibration Pass
description: Carry a calibrated stereo-imaging head on a low vibration-isolated mount on a four-module square body. Keep the cameras facing the rack and slide left along a 9 m rack face in about 100 seconds, stopping at six barcode panels. At the clear end bay, drive forward 0.8 m in 12 seconds and slide right along the adjacent rack to complete the return scan.
payload_desc: Calibrated stereo-imaging head, isolation mount and recorder
motion_rationale: Both rack scans use a 0.098 m/s lateral peak for approximately 100 seconds of movement per 9 m face, while the gentle end-bay offset needs a 0.074 m/s forward peak.

title: Trailer Side Channel Unload
description: Use a fore-and-aft pair to carry small accessory cartons from a stationary trailer through the 0.29 m clear channel beside its secured freight. Drive forward 8 m in about 85 seconds to reach the loader, then reverse along the channel with the loaded tray. Continue onto the indoor bay across a level, flush steel bridge plate; no turn or sideways correction is required.
payload_desc: Restrained tray of small accessory cartons at loaded return
motion_rationale: Forward entry and loaded reverse exit use a 0.101 m/s surge peak to traverse each 8 m channel leg in roughly 85 seconds with controlled stops and only 45 mm clearance on either side.

title: Chilled Tote Stop Alignment
description: Carry a sealed chilled-food tote on a cold-rated two-module body to a manual picking stop in the refrigerated aisle. Drive forward 5.6 m in about 50 seconds, then slide left 0.24 m in 18 seconds to align the tote with two painted stop marks. Use 0.004 m/s for the last 24 mm and reverse 0.6 m after the operator removes the tote.
payload_desc: Sealed tote of chilled packaged food
motion_rationale: A 0.121 m/s surge peak supports the aisle approach and slower reverse departure, while a 0.02 m/s leftward peak leaves six seconds for the final 24 mm alignment at 0.004 m/s.

title: Mezzanine Conveyor Feed Loop
description: Move a tray of small cartons between a mezzanine packing bench and a stopped conveyor feed position on the same level. Drive forward 7 m in about 38 seconds, turn clockwise 90 degrees in 3.5 seconds, and go diagonally front-right 1.4 m in 10 seconds around a fixed cabinet. Slide left 0.2 m in 8 seconds for staff to transfer the cartons, then reverse 1 m clear of the conveyor.
payload_desc: Low tray of small sealed shipping cartons
motion_rationale: The bench lane needs a 0.198 m/s surge peak, the cabinet diagonal needs 0.153 m/s, the transfer slide needs 0.029 m/s, and the 3.5-second quarter-turn needs a 31 deg/s yaw peak.

title: Returns Tray Scale Positioning
description: Carry a tray of returned watch straps on one module from the inspection bench to a scale-side pickup mark. Go diagonally rear-left 1.2 m in about 15 seconds to clear the bench corner, then slide right 0.15 m in 14 seconds beneath the pickup guide. Finish the last 15 mm at 0.003 m/s so the operator can lift the tray straight onto the scale.
payload_desc: Small returns tray containing packaged watch straps
motion_rationale: Clearing the bench corner requires a 0.088 m/s rear-left diagonal peak, while the 0.017 m/s rightward peak allows five seconds for the final 15 mm at 0.003 m/s.

title: Mobile Rack Label Sprint
description: Carry a light packet of replacement location labels on a four-module square body down an opened mobile-racking aisle. Once the rack controls confirm the aisle is locked open, drive forward 24 m in about 95 seconds to the technician. Reverse along the same straight route after handoff; do not turn between the rack faces.

constraints: racking locked open for entire job
clear floor tracks with flush crossings

payload_desc: Packet of rack-location labels and a compact applicator
motion_rationale: The light-load delivery and reverse return need a near-limit 0.264 m/s surge peak to cover each 24 m aisle leg in about 95 seconds with controlled acceleration and stopping.

title: Pharmacy Tote Diagonal Dock
description: Carry a compartmented prescription tote on a four-module square body from the checking bench to a staff unloading dock. Drive forward 3.2 m in about 20 seconds, turn counter-clockwise 45 degrees in 5 seconds to match the dock face, then approach diagonally front-right for 0.9 m in about 14 seconds between two guide posts. Slide left 30 mm at 0.005 m/s for final alignment, and withdraw diagonally rear-left after staff unload the tote.
payload_desc: Closed compartmented tote of checked prescription packages
motion_rationale: The bench leg needs a 0.174 m/s forward peak, the five-second heading change needs 11 deg/s, the dock approach and withdrawal use a 0.073 m/s diagonal peak, and the final 30 mm left correction takes six seconds at 0.005 m/s.

title: Align Samples With Analyzer Shelf
description: Carry a sealed sample rack along the 3 m lab aisle to an analyzer receiving shelf. Drive forward with a 2 m cruise section covered in 20 seconds, then slide right 60 mm over 6 seconds to align the rack for manual transfer; keep the same heading throughout.
payload_desc: Sealed sample tubes in a restrained rack
motion_rationale: The straight cruise needs 0.10 m/s forward, while the 60 mm rightward alignment over 6 seconds needs only 0.01 m/s sideways.

title: Rush Empty Trays To Restocking
description: Use a six-module 0.6 by 0.4 m body to carry a broad stack of empty display trays from receiving to the restocking bench. Travel forward down the clear backroom lane, covering its 13 m cruise section in 50 seconds, then slide left through a 0.9 m bench opening with a 0.6 m cruise section taking 5 seconds.
payload_desc: Nested lightweight display trays secured across six decks
motion_rationale: The 13 m transit section in 50 seconds requires 0.26 m/s forward, and the 0.6 m leftward section in 5 seconds requires 0.12 m/s sway.

title: Thread Anchors Between Installed Cabinets
description: Carry boxed wall anchors on a 0.4 m square body across a finished indoor construction slab. Advance through a 0.46 m passage between fixed cabinets, covering a 1.2 m cruise section in 20 seconds, then slide right into the installation pocket with a 0.24 m cruise section taking 8 seconds; there is no room to turn.
payload_desc: Four restrained boxes of wall anchors and fasteners
motion_rationale: The close cabinet passage limits forward travel to 1.2 m in 20 seconds, or 0.06 m/s, and the rightward pocket entry uses 0.24 m in 8 seconds, or 0.03 m/s.

title: Move Camera Through Product Shot
description: Carry a small cinema camera on a low vibration-isolated mount along a taped studio dolly path. Slide left through a 1.2 m constant-speed filming section in 30 seconds, then reverse along a 0.6 m clearance section in 10 seconds after the take; preserve the camera heading and use gentle starts and stops.
payload_desc: Compact cinema camera with low mount and battery
motion_rationale: The filming traverse requires 0.04 m/s leftward sway, and the post-take reverse clearance section requires 0.06 m/s.

title: Deliver Gallery Label Repair Kit
description: Carry a label repair kit to four plinths in an empty gallery after closing.
