description: Carry dressings and evacuation labels from the nurses' station to a staffed holding area along a cleared hospital corridor. Cover the 12 m straight section in about 60 seconds, slide right 0.6 m in 10 seconds between parked stretchers, then turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees in 6 seconds at the holding bay. Reverse 1 m in 10 seconds after staff unload the tray.
payload_desc: Latched tray of dressings, evacuation labels, and patient blankets
motion_rationale: Forward travel peaks at 0.21 m/s to cover the 12 m corridor in roughly 60 seconds, the short reverse uses a lower speed, the stretcher gap requires a 0.065 m/s right slide, and the six-second quarter-turn peaks at 16 deg/s.

title: Pass Supplies Across Stair Landing
description: Carry a radio battery and smoke hood across the flat landing to a responder stationed at a fire door. Move forward 1.4 m in about 20 seconds, then slide left 0.45 m in 15 seconds through a 0.29 m gap between a fixed cabinet and the wall without changing heading. Reverse to the staging mark after unloading; the route never enters the stairs.
payload_desc: Radio battery and packaged smoke hood in a clipped tray
motion_rationale: The 1.4 m approach and subsequent reverse need at most 0.075 m/s, while the narrow landing gap limits the 0.45 m left slide to a 0.032 m/s peak.

title: Distribute Fire Aftermath Sampling Kits
description: Deliver sealed sampling kits to four investigators working in a warehouse cleared for entry after a fire. Follow four 5 m straight legs in about 30 seconds each and turn in place at the marked junction pads, using three clockwise quarter-turns and one counter-clockwise quarter-turn. Each turn takes about 3 seconds so the tray handle faces the investigator before handoff.
payload_desc: Secured case of sample jars, labels, and disposable gloves
motion_rationale: The five-metre legs require a 0.18 m/s forward peak, and repeated three-second quarter-turns require a 38 deg/s yaw peak with acceleration and settling.

title: Dock Supplies Inside Evacuation Carriage
description: Move a strapped emergency supply chest from the vestibule to a responder's transfer shelf inside a stationary train carriage. The six-module body follows 9 m of cleared aisle in about 65 seconds, then approaches the recessed shelf diagonally front-left along a 0.85 m path in 18 seconds without turning. After unloading, withdraw diagonally rear-right along the same path.
payload_desc: Low emergency supply chest containing blankets, dressings, and bottled water
motion_rationale: The nine-metre aisle transit peaks at 0.15 m/s, while the 0.85 m diagonal docking and withdrawal paths peak at 0.052 m/s to allow careful shelf alignment.

title: Resupply Refuge Chamber Benches
description: Carry sealed drinking-water pouches from the refuge chamber cache to the far occupied bench in a chamber cleared for robot use. Travel forward 4 m in 35 seconds, slide left 0.7 m in 12 seconds around a fixed table, and turn clockwise 90 degrees in 9 seconds to present the tray. Reverse 0.8 m in 12 seconds after handoff.
payload_desc: Secured shallow crate of sealed drinking-water pouches
motion_rationale: The four-metre delivery leg needs a 0.125 m/s forward peak with slower reverse clearance, the table bypass needs 0.064 m/s left sway, and the nine-second quarter-turn peaks at 12 deg/s.

title: Align Cold Aisle Sensor Dock
description: Carry a temperature and airflow logger down 14 m of cold aisle in about 80 seconds to a floor-level calibration dock beside the final rack. Keep the four-module square facing down the aisle and approach the dock diagonally front-right over 0.64 m in 16 seconds. Withdraw diagonally rear-left after the calibration dwell.
payload_desc: Low-mounted temperature and airflow logger with calibration interface
motion_rationale: A 0.185 m/s forward peak supports the 14 m transit, while the sixteen-second diagonal approach and withdrawal need only 0.045 m/s for dock alignment.

title: Rush Inverter Thermal Check
description: Carry a compact thermal logger from the indoor service desk to an inverter cabinet before a scheduled load test ends. Cover the clear 18 m service lane in about 70 seconds, then slide right 0.5 m in 8 seconds to the marked measurement position. Hold there for the reading without turning.
payload_desc: Compact thermal logger on a secured low bracket
motion_rationale: The 18 m deadline requires a near-limit 0.268 m/s forward peak, followed by a 0.071 m/s right slide to settle at the cabinet mark within eight seconds.

title: Survey Beneath Aircraft Wing
description: Carry an upward-facing camera under a parked aircraft wing to photograph three marked inspection points. Move forward 6 m in 40 seconds, slide left 1.2 m in 15 seconds beside a wheel exclusion zone, then travel diagonally front-right 2 m in 20 seconds to the final mark. Turn counter-clockwise 45 degrees in 6 seconds there to frame the last image.
payload_desc: Upward-facing inspection camera, light, and battery pack
motion_rationale: The timed legs require peaks of 0.16 m/s forward, 0.087 m/s left, and 0.11 m/s diagonally front-right, followed by a 9 deg/s yaw peak for the six-second camera framing turn.

title: Inspect Engine Room Blind Bays
description: Carry a vibration recorder into two blind service bays on a stationary ship's level engine-room deck. Enter each 3.6 m bay in about 30 seconds, stop beside the bearing housing for a reading, and reverse the full distance in about 40 seconds because the six-module body cannot turn inside. At the open junction, turn clockwise 90 degrees in 7 seconds before entering the second bay.
payload_desc: Vibration recorder and secured acoustic sensor assembly
motion_rationale: Bay entry peaks at 0.13 m/s and reverse withdrawal runs more slowly to meet the forty-second exit allowance, while the junction quarter-turn peaks at 15 deg/s.

title: Traverse Turbine Hall Survey Line
description: Carry a compact acoustic logger along a 48 m marked line beside the turbine enclosure in about 190 seconds. Keep the same heading and return in reverse along the line in about 220 seconds after the end-point recording. The route stays in the accessible turbine hall and does not pass through controlled radiation areas.
payload_desc: Compact acoustic logger and low microphone mount
motion_rationale: The 48 m outbound run requires a 0.26 m/s peak to finish in roughly 190 seconds, with a slower reverse return and no lateral movement or rotation.

title: Survey Pipe Gallery Leak Marks
description: Carry a humidity probe and camera between three marked pipe joints in an enclosed gallery. Advance 7 m in 55 seconds, slide right 0.8 m in 16 seconds through the space between support feet, and move diagonally rear-left 0.9 m in 15 seconds to view a joint behind a brace. Turn clockwise 60 degrees in 8 seconds at the widened inspection pocket.
payload_desc: Splash-protected humidity probe and inspection camera
motion_rationale: The damp gallery's timed legs call for peaks of 0.14 m/s forward, 0.055 m/s right, and 0.066 m/s diagonally rear-left, with a 9 deg/s turn confined to the inspection pocket.

title: Reverse From Bridge Inspection Spur
description: Carry an upward-looking camera rig along the enclosed, level maintenance walkway beneath the bridge deck. Enter a 10 m blind spur in about 80 seconds, record the end bearing, and reverse out in about 100 seconds because the six-module body has no turning space. The entire route stays inside the covered walkway on flush steel plates.
payload_desc: Low upward-looking camera rig with lighting and battery enclosure
motion_rationale: The ten-metre approach peaks at 0.135 m/s, while the longer reverse allowance permits a slower withdrawal along the same narrow spur without rotation.

title: Record Nacelle Service Lane
description: Carry a low thermal camera along the 8.4 m straight service lane inside a stopped wind-turbine nacelle. Complete the forward imaging pass in about 55 seconds and reverse to the access staging mark in about 65 seconds without turning beside the machinery. The modules are placed on the nacelle's level floor before the job starts.
payload_desc: Low thermal camera and onboard recording unit
motion_rationale: The 8.4 m imaging pass needs a 0.165 m/s forward peak, with a slower reverse return fitting the sixty-five-second allowance in the same straight lane.

title: Position Cleanroom Metrology Fixture
description: Move a heavy enclosed metrology fixture from its storage stand to a floor-level inspection station in the cleanroom bay. Carry it forward 11 m in about 90 seconds, then slide left 0.32 m in 16 seconds to align its optical window with the station target. Keep the four-module square at the same heading throughout and wait while the technician records the measurement.
payload_desc: Enclosed metrology fixture with a low-mounted optical head
motion_rationale: The heavy fixture's eleven-metre transfer peaks at 0.132 m/s, while the sixteen-second optical alignment limits the left slide to 0.023 m/s.

title: Reposition Column Scanning Rig
description: Carry a compact laser scanner and its heavy calibration base between two columns on one level of an enclosed parking structure. Cross the closed 16 m traffic lane in about 100 seconds, turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees in 10 seconds within a marked clear square, then slide right 1.1 m in 22 seconds to establish the second scan position. Stop fully before each scan.
payload_desc: Low laser scanner, battery, and weighted calibration base
motion_rationale: The sixteen-metre crossing needs a 0.172 m/s forward peak, the second scan position needs 0.056 m/s right sway, and the heavy base's ten-second quarter-turn peaks at 11 deg/s.

title: Deliver Ward Fluid Cartons
description: Carry two secured cartons of infusion fluids from the ward store to the treatment-room receiving mark. Cover a 24 m straight corridor in about 140 seconds, turn clockwise 90 degrees in 8 seconds at a widened junction, and slide left 0.6 m in 15 seconds beside the receiving bench. Staff lift the cartons off before the body reverses 1.2 m in 15 seconds.
payload_desc: Two strapped cartons of packaged infusion fluids
motion_rationale: The loaded corridor run peaks at 0.183 m/s with slower reverse clearance after unloading, while bench alignment needs 0.045 m/s left sway and the junction turn peaks at 14 deg/s.

title: Place Breakfast Tray At Suite
description: Carry a covered breakfast tray along 15 m of hotel corridor in about 110 seconds. Turn counter-clockwise 90 degrees in 10 seconds at the suite alcove, then approach the waiting attendant diagonally front-right over 0.75 m in 15 seconds. Once the tray is removed, slide left 0.5 m in 10 seconds to clear the door swing and reverse 1 m in 12 seconds.
payload_desc: Covered breakfast tray with dishes secured in a fitted carrier
motion_rationale: The carpeted corridor needs a 0.148 m/s forward peak and a slower reverse exit, while the alcove requires an 11 deg/s turn, a 0.057 m/s diagonal approach, and a 0.056 m/s left clearance slide.

title: Collect Baggage Scanner Consumables
description: Carry a sealed box of scanner cleaning supplies into the blind service lane behind a baggage inspection station. Travel forward 6.5 m in about 35 seconds, wait for the technician to remove the box, then reverse the same distance in about 45 seconds. Maintain the original heading because belt supports leave no turning space.
payload_desc: Sealed box of baggage scanner cleaning supplies
motion_rationale: The 6.5 m service-lane entry peaks at 0.20 m/s, while reverse withdrawal is slower to fit the forty-five-second allowance without turning near belt supports.

title: Deliver Fragile Ceramic Kit
description: Carry a foam-lined kit of ceramic sensor housings from the kitting rack to an assembly operator. Travel 8 m forward in about 100 seconds, then slide right 0.4 m in 20 seconds to place the tray beside the operator's fixture without rotating it. Pause for unloading and reverse 0.8 m in 16 seconds with gentle starts and stops.
payload_desc: Foam-lined tray of fragile ceramic sensor housings
motion_rationale: The fragile kit's hundred-second forward transfer peaks at 0.09 m/s with a slower short reverse, and the twenty-second fixture alignment needs a 0.024 m/s right slide.

title: Shuttle Returned Books To Sorting
description: Carry a clipped bin of returned paperbacks from the indoor return desk to the sorting station at the far end of a straight 30 m staff aisle. Complete the loaded run in about 120 seconds, wait while the sorter exchanges the bin, and reverse along the same aisle in about 135 seconds. Both stations accept the bin at the same body heading.
payload_desc: Clipped low bin of returned paperbacks
motion_rationale: The thirty-metre loaded run requires a 0.262 m/s forward peak, with a lower reverse speed fitting the longer return allowance and no need to change heading.

title: Present Samples At Laboratory Stations
description: Carry a sealed sample carrier between four laboratory receiving stands connected by 3 m straight lanes. Cover each of the three lanes in about 25 seconds and turn in place at every receiving stand to present the carrier latch, alternating clockwise and counter-clockwise quarter-turns. Allow about 7 seconds for each turn so the tubes remain settled in their inserts.
payload_desc: Sealed secondary carrier containing capped sample tubes
motion_rationale: Each three-metre lane needs a 0.135 m/s forward peak, while the repeated seven-second quarter-turns peak at 17 deg/s to accommodate gentle angular acceleration.

title: Restock Blind Backroom Shelf
description: Carry a shallow crate of bottled toiletries into a blind backroom aisle where a stocker is replenishing the lowest shelf. Enter the 4.8 m aisle in about 30 seconds, slide left 0.18 m in 9 seconds for handoff, then slide right to the aisle centre after unloading. Reverse out in about 40 seconds because the shelf ends prevent a turn.
payload_desc: Shallow crate of boxed bottled toiletries
motion_rationale: A 0.175 m/s forward peak supports the thirty-second entry with slower reverse withdrawal, while the paired nine-second shelf alignment slides peak at 0.024 m/s.

title: Carry Glazed Tile Test Panels
description: Move a padded crate of glazed tile test panels across a swept indoor slab to the finishing contractor's bench. Travel forward 9 m in about 120 seconds, then go diagonally front-left along a 1.4 m clear path in 28 seconds between two material stacks. Slide right 0.25 m in 12 seconds for unloading while keeping the crate at the same heading.

constraints: no cords or slab joints on route

payload_desc: Low padded crate of individually separated glazed tile test panels
motion_rationale: The padded panels require gentle peaks of 0.084 m/s on the nine-metre straight, 0.057 m/s on the diagonal stack bypass, and 0.025 m/s during final right alignment.

title: Move Low Camera Through Set
description: Carry a compact remotely operated camera through a floor-level product shot on an indoor soundstage. Track forward 3 m in 30 seconds, slide left 0.8 m in 16 seconds, then move diagonally rear-right 1.2 m in 20 seconds while keeping the lens trained using its gimbal. Finish with a clockwise 30-degree body turn in 10 seconds and reverse 1 m in 15 seconds to the reset mark.
payload_desc: Compact camera, small gimbal, and wireless video transmitter
motion_rationale: The shot timings require peaks of 0.108 m/s forward with a slower reverse reset, 0.055 m/s left, 0.067 m/s diagonally rear-right, and 3.6 deg/s for the ten-second finishing turn.

title: Deliver Gallery Label Supplies
description: Carry a secured case of replacement labels and mounting tools from the preparation room to a curator at the far end of a 36 m straight gallery route after closing. Complete the outward run in about 155 seconds, pause for the case exchange, then reverse along the same route in about 180 seconds. Stay between the marked exhibit setbacks without turning near display plinths.
payload_desc: Secured case of replacement labels, mounting tools, and protective pads
motion_rationale: The 36 m outward delivery needs a 0.245 m/s forward peak, while the longer reverse allowance supports a slower return without lateral motion or turns beside the exhibits.

title: Deliver Glass Infusion Bottles
description: Carry a padded tray of glass infusion bottles from the supply room to the ward hatch along an 18 m corridor, allowing 120 seconds for the straight travel. Keep the two-module body facing the hatch and slide 0.45 m left over 9 seconds beneath its receiving shelf. Staff lift the tray off without the robot turning.
payload_desc: Glass infusion bottles secured upright in a padded tray
motion_rationale: Forward travel peaks at 0.17 m/s to cover 18 m within 120 seconds with gentle starts, while the 0.45 m left slide peaks at 0.06 m/s to fit its 9-second alignment window.

title: Move Breakfast Service Trays
description: Carry three covered breakfast trays on a six-module rectangular deck along 24 m of hotel corridor in about three minutes. Turn clockwise through 90 degrees in the 1.5 m service lobby over 12 seconds, then slide 0.6 m right in 15 seconds to meet the room-service handoff table. Cups sit in recessed holders and the attendant removes the trays.
payload_desc: Three covered meal trays with ceramic dishes and hot drinks
motion_rationale: The 24 m corridor permits a 0.15 m/s forward peak with gentle acceleration, the 15-second right slide needs 0.05 m/s, and the 12-second quarter-turn needs a 9 deg/s yaw peak.

title: Transfer Dense Tool Baggage
description: Move a strapped 14.5 kg tool case from the oversize-baggage desk to the inspection table along a fenced 30 m lane. Cover the straight leg in 125 seconds, then slide 0.8 m left over 12 seconds beside the table without rotating the three-module body. A handler transfers the case at each end.
payload_desc: Dense airline tool case secured across three modules
motion_rationale: The 125-second deadline for 30 m requires a 0.26 m/s forward peak, while a slower 0.08 m/s left slide completes the 0.8 m table approach within 12 seconds.

title: Replenish Assembly Fixture Kits
description: Take a 6 kg component kit 12 m down the line in 65 seconds, then turn counter-clockwise through 90 degrees in the marked junction within 5 seconds. Travel 2.1 m diagonally front-right across the station apron in 14 seconds and slide 0.3 m right over 6 seconds into the handoff position. After the kit is removed, reverse 1.5 m out of the station over 12 seconds.
payload_desc: Partitioned tray of fasteners and assembly fixtures
motion_rationale: Forward and reverse legs use a shared 0.21 m/s peak ceiling, the apron diagonal peaks at 0.17 m/s, the short right alignment at 0.06 m/s, and the five-second quarter-turn at 22 deg/s.

title: Return Bound Journal Stacks
description: Carry a strapped stack of bound journals from the return counter to the shelving worktable through a 16 m aisle. Allow 110 seconds for the loaded straight leg and slide 0.5 m right in 10 seconds to present the stack to the librarian. Reverse along the same aisle after unloading because the worktable end has no turning space.
payload_desc: Bound journals in a shallow strapped book cradle
motion_rationale: A 0.17 m/s surge peak supports each 16 m aisle leg with soft starts, and a 0.06 m/s right slide places the heavy stack beside the table within 10 seconds.

title: Collect Samples From Analyzer Alcove
description: Enter a 5 m dead-end analyzer alcove carrying an empty secured sample carrier, taking about 50 seconds. A technician loads sealed sample tubes, after which the three-module strip must reverse the full 5 m in 70 seconds because it cannot turn between the benches. At the open end, slide 0.4 m left over 10 seconds to the collection hatch.
payload_desc: Secured insulated carrier containing sealed laboratory sample tubes
motion_rationale: Surge peaks at 0.12 m/s on entry and runs more slowly during the 70-second loaded reverse, while the hatch alignment needs a 0.05 m/s left-slide peak.

title: Restock Cosmetics Through Backroom
description: Carry a small cosmetics carton 9 m through the backroom in 45 seconds and turn clockwise through 90 degrees in the clear stockroom junction in 4 seconds. Cross a 1.4 m front-left diagonal gap between fixed cage corners in 10 seconds, then slide 0.35 m left over 7 seconds beside the shelf. Reverse 2 m over 15 seconds after staff remove the carton.
payload_desc: Closed carton of boxed cosmetics
motion_rationale: The 45-second straight leg needs a 0.23 m/s surge peak, the diagonal gap needs 0.16 m/s, the seven-second shelf slide needs 0.06 m/s, and the four-second turn peaks at 28 deg/s.

title: Deliver Fixings Into Service Recess
description: Carry two closed boxes of fixings along a swept indoor slab to a crew working in a 7 m dead-end service recess. Drive into the recess in 55 seconds, wait while the crew unloads, and reverse the same distance in 65 seconds without turning. Slide 0.6 m right in 10 seconds at the recess mouth to clear the next delivery.
payload_desc: Two strapped boxes of metal fixings on a four-module square
motion_rationale: A 0.15 m/s surge peak fits the loaded entry and slower reverse windows, while a 0.07 m/s right-slide peak clears the recess mouth within 10 seconds.

title: Track Tabletop Product Shot
description: Carry a compact camera and low mounting plate through a rehearsed tabletop product shot on the studio floor. Move forward 2.4 m in 30 seconds, slide 1.2 m left in 20 seconds, then travel 1.5 m diagonally rear-right in 25 seconds while keeping the camera heading fixed. Between takes, turn counter-clockwise through 30 degrees in 10 seconds and reverse to the taped starting position.
payload_desc: Compact cinema camera with a low rigid mounting plate
motion_rationale: The timed camera moves require gentle peaks of 0.09 m/s in surge, 0.07 m/s sideways and diagonally, with a 4 deg/s yaw peak for the ten-second between-take adjustment.

title: Distribute Gallery Label Packs
description: Carry a small pack of replacement labels and mounting clips to six exhibit plinths after closing. Travel 3 m between stops in about 20 seconds, turning in place clockwise or counter-clockwise at each open junction to face the next plinth. Each 90-degree reorientation has a 3-second movement window before the conservator collects the next packet.
payload_desc: Replacement label packets and mounting clips in a deck tray
motion_rationale: A 0.18 m/s forward peak covers the short inter-plinth legs with stops, and a 38 deg/s yaw peak accommodates repeated three-second quarter-turns in either direction.

title: Dock Beneath Angled Picking Shelf
description: Carry a picking tote 11 m along a narrow rack aisle in 60 seconds on a four-module square. At the widened aisle end, approach the receiving nest along a 1.7 m front-left diagonal over 16 seconds without changing heading. Finish with a 0.12 m left slide over 6 seconds to line up the tote transfer marks.
payload_desc: Picking tote containing bagged spare parts
motion_rationale: The aisle schedule needs a 0.21 m/s surge peak, the 16-second diagonal approach needs 0.12 m/s, and the six-second final alignment limits left sway to 0.025 m/s.

title: Shuttle Mini Pallet Across Dock
description: Carry a 32 kg strapped mini pallet, sized for an eight-module 0.8 by 0.4 m deck, between two floor-level cross-dock stations. Cover the 28 m fenced straight lane in 115 seconds, then follow a 2.8 m front-right diagonal into the receiving bay over 18 seconds. Slide 0.2 m right over 8 seconds for manual transfer onto the station.
payload_desc: Strapped mini pallet of compact boxed components
motion_rationale: The 28 m lane requires a near-full 0.265 m/s surge peak, the receiving diagonal peaks at 0.18 m/s, and the eight-second transfer alignment needs only 0.03 m/s right sway.

title: Present Tote Faces At Stations
description: Move a compartmented tote between three shelf ends and a packing station along 6 m connecting lanes, allowing 35 seconds per lane. At each 0.9 m square transfer pad, turn in place through 90 degrees in either direction to present the required tote face. Each turn takes 4 seconds, followed by a 0.25 m left or right slide over 5 seconds to the transfer edge.
payload_desc: Compartmented tote of packed electrical connectors
motion_rationale: The connecting lanes need a 0.2 m/s forward peak, each transfer slide peaks at 0.06 m/s, and four-second quarter-turns require 28 deg/s yaw in both directions.

title: Scan Long Rack Faces
description: Carry a low-mounted inventory camera along two 42 m rack faces, giving each straight scanning pass 170 seconds. At the open aisle end, slide 1.1 m right over 12 seconds and reverse down the second face while keeping the camera assembly at the same heading. Fixed cameras on opposite sides of the rig read the two rack faces.

constraints: rack labels visible from low mount

payload_desc: Low camera rig, barcode readers, and onboard recording battery
motion_rationale: Each 42 m scanning pass needs a near-full 0.265 m/s surge peak in its respective direction, while the 12-second aisle crossover requires a 0.11 m/s right-slide peak.

title: Unload Cartons Inside Level Trailer
description: Shuttle a strapped carton bundle from a handler inside a stationary trailer to a receiving table 8 m away inside the same trailer. Cover each loaded leg in 50 seconds and turn in place through 180 degrees at the marked clear pads at both ends, alternating clockwise and counter-clockwise turns over 7 seconds each. The six-module body stays entirely on the trailer floor throughout the job.

constraints: clear turning pads at both ends

payload_desc: Strapped bundle of small appliance cartons
motion_rationale: An 0.19 m/s forward peak supports the 50-second loaded leg, and seven-second half-turns need a 31 deg/s yaw peak suitable for the six-module body.

title: Rotate Chilled Ingredient Crates
description: Carry a lidded ingredient crate between four collection points in a chilled room using 5 m straight legs of about 40 seconds each. At each widened rack end, turn in place clockwise or counter-clockwise through 90 degrees over 8 seconds so the crate label faces the picker. Slide 0.3 m right over 10 seconds at the final weighing station.

constraints: turn only at widened rack ends

payload_desc: Lidded crate of chilled packaged ingredients
motion_rationale: The 40-second rack legs use a 0.15 m/s surge peak, deliberate eight-second quarter-turns peak at 14 deg/s, and the weighing-station slide peaks at 0.035 m/s.

title: Feed Dead-End Mezzanine Conveyor
description: Carry a small carton along a 6 m guarded mezzanine lane to a stopped conveyor feed shelf in 40 seconds. After an operator transfers the carton, reverse the full 6 m in 45 seconds because the conveyor enclosure blocks any turn. Slide 0.4 m left over 8 seconds into the waiting pocket at the lane entrance; all travel remains on the same mezzanine level.
payload_desc: Small sealed carton of packaged hardware
motion_rationale: A 0.18 m/s surge peak covers the six-metre entry and reverse legs with stopping allowance, while the eight-second waiting-pocket slide requires a 0.06 m/s left peak.

title: Run Returns To Inspection
description: Take a strapped returns tote down a 38 m segregated lane to the inspection bench in 155 seconds. Slide 0.5 m left over 7 seconds for unloading, then slide right back into the lane and reverse to the intake desk. The three-module strip keeps its heading throughout the out-and-back run.
payload_desc: Tote of boxed customer returns awaiting inspection
motion_rationale: The long timed lane requires a 0.265 m/s surge peak in both directions, and each seven-second half-metre transfer slide needs an 0.085 m/s sway peak.

title: Extract Dense Archive Parts Tote
description: Carry a 14.8 kg tote of metal spares out of a temporarily opened mobile-racking aisle on a three-module strip. Enter the 9 m aisle empty in 65 seconds, wait for staff to load the tote, and reverse out in 85 seconds because there is no turning pocket. Once fully clear of the racks, slide 0.7 m right over 14 seconds to the weighing bench.
payload_desc: Compact tote of dense metal maintenance spares
motion_rationale: Empty entry peaks at 0.16 m/s with a slower loaded reverse to fit the 85-second exit, and a 0.06 m/s right slide brings the heavy tote to the bench within 14 seconds.

title: Index Pharmacy Order Compartments
description: Carry a divided order tray around a pharmacy fulfilment cell with 2 m straight moves between dispensing counters, each taking 18 seconds. At five clear transfer pads, turn in place through 90 degrees clockwise or counter-clockwise over 10 seconds to present the correct compartment to the technician. Finish each presentation with a 0.1 m left slide over 5 seconds against the optical alignment marks.
payload_desc: Divided order tray containing sealed medicine packs
motion_rationale: Short counter-to-counter moves peak at 0.14 m/s, ten-second compartment quarter-turns peak at 11 deg/s, and the five-second optical alignment needs a 0.025 m/s left slide.

title: Place Acoustic Sensor Beyond Collapse
description: Carry a shock-isolated acoustic listening unit along an 8 m intact floor strip beside a partial corridor collapse, taking two minutes to reach the listening position. Keep the body heading fixed and slide 0.4 m left over 12 seconds into a cleared wall recess for a 60-second recording. Slide right out of the recess and reverse along the same cleared strip with the sensor still aboard.
payload_desc: Fragile acoustic listening unit in a shock-isolated cradle
motion_rationale: The two-minute approach and matching reverse allow a gentle 0.08 m/s surge peak, while twelve-second recess entry and exit slides peak at 0.04 m/s to protect the listening unit.

title: Search Blind Office Bays
description: Carry a low thermal camera and air sensor along a smoke-filled office corridor cleared for remote robot entry. Enter three 4 m dead-end office bays in about 45 seconds each and reverse out over the same interval because the furniture leaves no turning space. Between bays, turn in place through 90 degrees in the clear corridor junction over 6 seconds and advance to the next doorway.
payload_desc: Low thermal camera, air-quality sensor, and protected electronics pack
motion_rationale: Each 45-second bay entry or reverse needs a cautious 0.11 m/s surge peak, and six-second junction quarter-turns require an 18 deg/s yaw peak in either direction.

title: Carry Optical Survey Instrument
description: Take a padded optical survey instrument across a 10 m swept strip on an intact parking-garage slab in 100 seconds. Follow a 2.1 m front-right diagonal over 30 seconds between two stationary debris piles, then slide 0.3 m right over 10 seconds to the survey technician. Keep the instrument upright and make no turns while it is aboard.

constraints: no slab cracks or steps on route

payload_desc: Fragile optical survey instrument in a padded upright transport case
motion_rationale: The 100-second slab crossing peaks at 0.12 m/s, the constrained 30-second diagonal peaks at 0.08 m/s, and the final ten-second right slide peaks at 0.035 m/s.

title: Map Basement Water Entry Points
description: Carry a protected inspection camera between four leak observation points on a flat basement floor covered by a shallow water film. Move 3 m between points in about 50 seconds, then turn in place clockwise or counter-clockwise through 90 degrees over 12 seconds to aim the camera at each wall joint. Use a 0.2 m left or right slide over 8 seconds where pipe guards block a direct view.

constraints: water film no deeper than 3 mm
modules rated for shallow splash exposure
floor surveyed for holes and loose material

payload_desc: Splash-protected low inspection camera and recording pack
motion_rationale: Wet-floor transfers peak at 0.075 m/s to fit the 50-second legs, camera quarter-turns peak at 9 deg/s over 12 seconds, and eight-second viewing adjustments peak at 0.03 m/s sideways.

title: Transport Tunnel Crack Imaging Rig
description: Carry a fragile structured-light crack-imaging rig along 22 m of a level tunnel service passage after the floor route has been checked, allowing 200 seconds for the approach. Move 1.4 m diagonally rear-left over 25 seconds into a widened observation recess without rotating the rig, then hold still for a 90-second scan. Travel diagonally front-right out of the recess and reverse to the entry station with the rig aboard.
payload_desc: Structured-light projector and calibrated cameras in an isolation cradle
motion_rationale: The 200-second approach and return legs need a gentle 0.13 m/s surge peak, while each 25-second recess diagonal peaks at 0.065 m/s to preserve the imaging rig's alignment.
